name: Alleria Windrunner
text: We were--We are. He's not wrong to distrust the Void. I only wish he would trust me.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: You are a marvel to me, Arator.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Please know...

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: I feared that you coming to this place--fighting these horrors--would wear you down.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Harden your heart...

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: My vision has never been clearer Lothraxion, but I don't want to believe it.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Farewell, old friend...

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: I've seen you fight, $p. I know you can do more.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Entertained, Terminas? Come down here if you dare.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: There, base of the tower. That's the one in charge.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Damn, he's already torn his way in.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Not bad, but it's time to end this.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Good, since you will likely die without it. Now listen.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Powerful entities called domanaar command the Host in Xal'atath's name. One monitors a Nexus-Point nearby, but I haven't gotten close.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Light and Shadow--two sides of the same coin. With enough of a push, Light can become Shadow.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: We'll secure the canisters and disrupt their operations. Stay close, Arator.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Xal'atath doesn't spare her enemies without a reason. Find out what the ethereals are doing here.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Direct your zeal at our foes, Lothraxion. And remember that I'm not one of them.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: No, Lothraxion! $n, we need your eyes.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: It's her or us! We have to fight!

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Arator! No!

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Arator, you must ensure that no harm comes to Decimus. They have the answers we need. Trust me.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: And we need not create them where we might find allies. Decimus is more than they seem.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: You seek power, Decimus. Xal'atath will not give you what you want, but her defeat might. Join us.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Make ready. It's time we claim the Mantle of Predation.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: All this time, Lothraxion thought that my judgment had been compromised by the Void.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Now his zealotry threatens all of Silvermoon.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Perhaps. For a thousand years, I saw the Light bolster the resolve of its champions. But it also... changed them.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Lothraxion was obviously no exception. And neither was Turalyon.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: More than anything, that was what I feared for you, Arator. Not that you would come to harm, but that the Light would alter you forever.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: That in the face of peril, you, like Lothraxion, would lose yourself to wrath. Like I risk losing myself to the Void.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Then let us save Silvermoon together. As Windrunners.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: You shouldn't be here, Arator. The Void is too powerful.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: We must be cautious. My attempts to infiltrate this place alone have been thwarted.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: They will even shackle their own kind? Interesting. Some even seem willing.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: It's over...

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Come, through the portal.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Xal'atath... was once mortal?

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: (grunts)

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: I never wanted you to see this...

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: (grunts)

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: (breathing heavily)

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: (grunts)

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: (shouts)

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: (gasping)

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: (gasps)

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: We failed...

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Lothraxion! Give up this foolishness. We have already won!

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: This is no time to go off on your own!

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Challenge Torentia and claim her sigil. Arator, let's regroup with the others in the upper citadel.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: You abandoned them?

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Remain here, Lothraxion. You've already put this mission at risk.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Stay together. No one fights alone, no one gets left behind.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: What did I miss? Why wait until now to betray us?

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Weapons ready. We'll make ourselves an opening and deal with Decimus afterward.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: No, something's not right. Decimus would not miss this spectacle.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: This was Decimus's plan. Keep Terminas's eyes on us, $p.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Arator! Stop them!

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: We need to stop him. Maella, get the others back to Howling Ridge.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Don't you think we have enough enemies ahead of us? I'll take allies where I can get them.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: About your father. When he--wait. Did you hear that?

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Give Lor'themar my report. Tell him... we did what we had to.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: And you fight well. But don't be in a rush to make your own.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: How proud I am of the man you've become.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: As it has mine.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: This is no place for pleasantries. We must move, quickly!

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: I wish Turalyon were here. Lothraxion might listen to him.

name: Alleria Windrunner
text: Make haste. We should have the Mantle before Terminas returns to his citadel.

name: Anduin Wrynn
text: We need to move the wounded!

name: Anduin Wrynn
text: Go join the Vanguard, Faerin! I'll escort everyone to the Sunwell.

name: Anduin Wrynn
text: We can't ignore their plight, but my hands are tied here at the Sunwell. I need your help with this. Find those deserters and get them free.

name: Anduin Wrynn
text: High Commander. You will release Magister Umbric, if you please.

name: Anduin Wrynn
text: They have. To me. Time and time again, Umbric and his ren'dorei have shown their loyalty to the alliance despite persecution and distrust.

name: Anduin Wrynn
text: You do not have the time to imprison him nor the grounds to execute him.

name: Anduin Wrynn
text: Is fond of 'bold' actions. Is that what I heard you say, Grand Magister?

name: Anduin Wrynn
text: Now is the time for bold actions. Release him, I accept full responsibility.

name: Anduin Wrynn
text: Valeera, I've received reports of cultists within the Twilight's Blade who want out. But they're terrified of getting caught while escaping.

name: Arator
text: That sounds like Kasiea. I wonder if she left anything behind? Let's go see.

name: Arator
text: This isn't right. See what's in that lockbox she was toying with.

name: Arator
text: I will not stand by as that cult takes this town!

name: Arator
text: I thought you and Lothraxion were friends.

name: Arator
text: Trouble ahead! On your guard!

name: Arator
text: You're safe! Have you seen Umbric?

name: Arator
text: That creature must have come from the Lightbloom! We should let the Magistrix know.

name: Arator
text: The Vanguard has faith in the Light, and so do I. But I've also felt it fill me with wrath, and I... I'm not sure what to think when it does.

name: Arator
text: I... want to come back here and help you, once this war has ended. I think this is as much my calling as facing down the horrors of the Void.

name: Arator
text: My father was one of those students. He's never mentioned any of this to me.

name: Arator
text: We've destabilized the pylon network, Decimus.

name: Arator
text: Time to make good on your promise--

name: Arator
text: I knew it would work.

name: Arator
text: Mother, I--

name: Arator
text: That could never happen.

name: Arator
text: I have something this darkness could never touch...

name: Arator
text: All those years alone, mother...

name: Arator
text: I finally have what I always longed for.

name: Arator
text: You.

name: Arator
text: I can't face those gathered at the Sunwell right now.

name: Arator
text: I won't let that happen. Go, check on your people--I need to tell Silvermoon what's happened here. I'll catch up with you.

name: Arator
text: The Scarlet Crusade? You, of all people, want to spread their Light?

name: Arator
text: There seems to be a few pieces missing. We have to find them if we're going to stop Lothraxion!

name: Arator
text: You put all of Silvermoon in danger. This isn't worth the risk!

name: Arator
text: Lothraxion, this isn't what the Light demands of us.

name: Arator
text: Think of the lives that will be lost--just trust us.

name: Arator
text: The console is working--starting the bridge now!

name: Arator
text: I suppose I'll need to figure out what to do with this shield.

name: Arator
text: I'm sure Lothraxion felt the same.

name: Arator
text: This is horrific--Fairbreeze was nothing compared to it.

name: Arator
text: $n! Over here!

name: Arator
text: Let's find the rest of the Vanguard. The High Exarch hates to be disappointed.

name: Arator
text: That's not much of an answer. Hm.

name: Arator
text: Come on, $p. Let's clear a path for the survivors!

name: Arator
text: Is this what it means to be a Sunwalker?

name: Arator
text: It is done. The way is clear.

name: Arator
text: By the Light, suffer no more.

name: Arator
text: The Holy Light will ease your pain.

name: Arator
text: Let the Light heal your wounds.

name: Arator
text: Allow the Light to be your guide.

name: Arator
text: Clear the skies and rescue any survivors you can find!

name: Arator
text: They've sunk a ship! Throw the survivor a rope!

name: Arator
text: You got them all! Thank the Light!

name: Arator
text: $n, find Umbric. I'll keep guard here.

name: Arator
text: You live up to your legend, mother.

name: Arator
text: Mount up, $n. We must get to the gate before the Vanguard attacks!

name: Arator
text: My father is eager to vanquish the Host, but charging forward won't be enough. We have to take out that pylon.

name: Arator
text: This isn't the type of thing the Silver Hand gets involved in, is it?

name: Arator
text: $n, wait! It's an ambush!

name: Arator
text: Mother--

name: Arator
text: Well... I've been giving it some thought. I'd like to hang it on the wall here. As a reminder.

name: Arator
text: We can all break, but we can put ourselves back together, and emerge stronger for it.

name: Arator
text: I... But it's not my shield.

name: Arator
text: The Dark Horde seems traumatized by this battle. They remain here and fight a war long lost.

name: Arator
text: My father, Turalyon, fought in this battle, though he has rarely talked to me about it.

name: Arator
text: After Anduin Lothar fell in battle, my father rallied the Alliance to victory.

name: Arator
text: Cease!

name: Arator
text: Leave it to us! We'll clear the chamber!

name: Arator
text: Hold, $n. There's a body here. What's that clutched in her hand?

name: Arator
text: We'll fix up those old constructs and take out any cultists we find.

name: Arator
text: And Shadow can become Light. I see, mother. We can use their own materials to bind and capture that domanaar.

name: Arator
text: Asking for me to inspire anyone? Faol always was an original thinker.

name: Arator
text: That weapon... the lightwood... they aren't trying to conquer Eversong. They're trying to defend themselves from the Twilight's Blade.

name: Arator
text: All is not lost, Umbric. They can't have stolen everything.

name: Arator
text: If this were deliberate, they would have attacked once Suncrown fell. There's more to this.

name: Arator
text: The Second War ended decades ago. I won't let them shatter the peace you bled for.

name: Arator
text: I'll go on ahead--catch up when you can.

name: Arator
text: All the creatures here seem to be immersed in Void, down to the smallest mite. Stay sharp.

name: Arator
text: That's your solution? To zap them with your staff?

name: Arator
text: No better place to take my mind off the problems with paladins.

name: Arator
text: $n! I was just about to begin. It will be a test of skill, but I can repair this.

name: Arator
text: That's what I've been trying to do since I joined the Silver Hand.

name: Arator
text: I was about to say the same to you.

name: Arator
text: This cannot stand. I'm with you, Lothraxion.

name: Arator
text: Odd for him to be lugging that around.

name: Arator
text: The final shield fragment. And I think I know whose it was.

name: Arator
text: This is one of the fragments that we're looking for. Might have been from a piece of armor or a shield.

name: Arator
text: There! Imprisoned within that shield!

name: Arator
text: The Void! It's too much!

name: Arator
text: The Light... it burns with Lothraxion's wrath... just like my father's...

name: Arator
text: Mother, the toll you've taken... We should fall back and recover.

name: Arator
text: This is the place--covered in runes and well warded, it seems.

name: Arator
text: If they were this well guarded, we'll want to take care ahead. Follow me, and keep quiet.

name: Arator
text: I suspect the Amani didn't want any uninvited guests. Lucky these wards are old.

name: Arator
text: More magic blocking the way. These tiles may offer a solution.

name: Arator
text: This is Faol's third lesson. What have you old meddlers got planned for me?

name: Arator
text: I'm not just upset that my father cut me down.

name: Arator
text: I'm upset that when he did so... I saw the Light shining brightly in his eyes.

name: Arator
text: The same Light that I am taught to revere. Under its guidance, he almost killed me.

name: Arator
text: Ha! You did it!

name: Arator
text: Quickly, we need to get to Amani Pass and tell them the truth of what is happening!

name: Arator
text: I've studied the Second War, but to everyone here, it's more than history. They lived through it.

name: Arator
text: Why did Faol bring me here? There has to be something he hasn't told me about this relic.

name: Arator
text: ...and they've locked the way forward. Come on, $n. We need to follow them.

name: Arator
text: We have to stop this!

name: Arator
text: We have to move!

name: Arator
text: It's the Twilight's Blade! They're the true threat!

name: Arator
text: This bloodshed... it's madness. Where is my father? He must see this by now!

name: Arator
text: By the Light's mercy, I command you both to yield! We have no shortage of enemies!

name: Arator
text: I've known the stories of these paladins since I was a child.

name: Arator
text: Each of them is a legend immortalized in stone. Their great deeds set an example for all paladins.

name: Arator
text: But no matter how hard I try... I fear that I'll never live up to them.

name: Arator
text: I can scarcely believe that the Light answers their call.

name: Arator
text: I was always taught that the Light was good. The Crusade is... unconscionable.

name: Arator
text: Uther was the first and greatest of the Silver Hand Paladins. I'm surprised not to find his hammer, but a healing kit.

name: Arator
text: Krohm defended the people of Lordaeron. But the relic is a smithing hammer, not a weapon.

name: Arator
text: This place has all the trappings of the Church of Holy Light, but turned to an evil purpose.

name: Arator
text: Mara's heroics inspired the creation of the Silver Hand. Her relic is a book of refugee prayers though.

name: Arator
text: Looks like a piece of an old shield.

name: Arator
text: I have often wondered.

name: Arator
text: This bush was trampled--the poor wildlife here must be terrified.

name: Arator
text: Maraad was known for his skill in combat, yet his relic is a meditation crystal.

name: Arator
text: That wasn't right. Let's try again.

name: Arator
text: Ugh! It looks--and smells--like the local pets were marking their territory. They're obviously distressed.

name: Arator
text: This nest... it's being choked by the Lightbloom growth. Let's fix this.

name: Arator
text: Lena led an army against the Legion. Why would her relic be something like this?

name: Arator
text: We'll take care of the reinforcements--go with Valeera!

name: Arator
text: Given who Lothraxion was before he embraced the Light...

name: Arator
text: You ren'dorei may be our greatest weapon against the Void. I swear to protect you all.

name: Arator
text: Maybe his conviction was the only thing that could anchor him in a place like this.

name: Arator
text: I've seen this before. In the Scarlet Crusade, in father, even in myself.

name: Arator
text: I... understand. But I promise you that it will never happen. Not for me, and not for you.

name: Arator
text: We're Windrunners, after all. No outside force has ever succeeded in telling us what to do.

name: Arator
text: Right ahead, $p! Let's take it down together!

name: Arator
text: This whole expedition has something to do with my father, doesn't it?

name: Arator
text: Please forgive my father's tone. We don't always see eye-to-eye on things, to say the least.

name: Arator
text: High Exarch Turalyon is a vaunted battlefield commander. Though... I think he sometimes forgets how to be anything else.

name: Arator
text: My mother, Alleria, would know better than anyone how to fight the Void. But I haven't seen her for weeks. I just hope...

name: Arator
text: Let's... focus on activating the sentinels.

name: Arator
text: You're Orweyna, aren't you? My mother Alleria told me about you.

name: Arator
text: We need to report back to Silvermoon. They need to know about this.

name: Arator
text: Mother said you're familiar with the wilds. What do you make of all this?

name: Arator
text: These creatures seem Light-blessed, but they're so... vicious.

name: Arator
text: You got the last conduit? Make sure to send them over.

name: Arator
text: Let's split up. We can cover more ground. I'll meet up with the two of you later.

name: Arator
text: Quickly, there's a runestone nearby. Let's get to safety and take a look.

name: Arator
text: Lord Tyrosus, I had no idea things were so desperate. What can we do to help?

name: Arator
text: I fear if I were stationed here to fight the Scourge, I'd become just like my fath--I'd fall to rage and wrath.

name: Arator
text: I shouldn't let my doubts get in the way of the defense of this place.

name: Arator
text: But is this what it means to wield the Light? An endless battle against evil?

name: Arator
text: Light's Hope is in danger. The world is in danger. I need to get my head in the battle.

name: Arator
text: I thought the Lightbloom could aid the Vanguard... but were they the ones to cause this?

name: Arator
text: The Light will protect you!

name: Arator
text: You will not fall today!

name: Arator
text: I do. I will.

name: Arator
text: We are trained to wield the Light as a weapon. Is that all that I am as a paladin?

name: Arator
text: You founded the Silver Hand. You trained my father. I suppose I blame you as well.

name: Arator
text: You crafted this philosophy of war. I followed your teachings until I burned myself with my own wrath.

name: Arator
text: What?

name: Arator
text: I'm... still not sure what happened in that moment. But I'll have to worry about it later. We have lives to save.

name: Arator
text: What are you saying?

name: Arator
text: Go! If you wish to surrender, give us your weapon, leave this accursed place, and never return.

name: Arator
text: Will these initiates forever call forth the Light through hatred?

name: Arator
text: It never ends, does it? Another will just continue this doctrine of spite.

name: Arator
text: This blade was forged long before the Crusade's hatred. Perhaps it can be returned to a wielder who is truly righteous.

name: Arator
text: Light soothe those wounds, little friend.

name: Arator
text: The mist ward is gone! Let's find Zul'jan.

name: Arator
text: None of this had to happen! Let's go.

name: Arator
text: Hammerfall? Is this about the Red Dawn?

name: Arator
text: This riddle must be the key to getting us out of here.

name: Arator
text: That look in Lothraxion's eyes is the same I saw in father's.

name: Arator
text: Why are you so eager to help us?

name: Arator
text: Then we'll fight it together. I'm not leaving you.

name: Arator
text: Don't forget to send the conduits.

name: Arator
text: Some of these captives aren't from Azeroth. How many worlds have suffered the Void's violence?

name: Arator
text: The Void gathers in great strength over here. We would be wise to disrupt them.

name: Arator
text: Their forces are seemingly endless. Fear not, $n. There will be a dawn yet.

name: Arator
text: Lor'themar, we found evidence of a nearby hideout--

name: Arator
text: The Light isn't harmless either. I've felt its fury. Seen the sacrifices it can compel us to make.

name: Arator
text: Then don't become numb to it! We all fight for the same cause.

name: Arator
text: Claim the Mantle. We'll watch your back.

name: Arator
text: Wait! There's no need for bloodshed.

name: Arator
text: Is this the fate of all paladins? Die a legend or live to be consumed by zealotry and wrath?

name: Arator
text: We have to find Zul'jan before it's too late.

name: Arator
text: I don't understand. They could have betrayed us at any time.

name: Arator
text: It's too hot! Pour some water on the shield to cool it.

name: Arator
text: This Lightbloom might actually be of use to the Vanguard. At the very least, I need to find out.

name: Arator
text: $p! Mount up! Retreat to the Sunwell!

name: Arator
text: Father.

name: Arator
text: I know you'd never willingly hurt me.

name: Arator
text: But in that moment,

name: Arator
text: you lost control.

name: Arator
text: $n, empower me with the Light and I'll try to restrain them!

name: Arator
text: I think...

name: Arator
text: It's time you forgave yourself.

name: Arator
text: I know what happened the day Lothar fell.

name: Arator
text: The guilt--

name: Arator
text: --the rage--

name: Arator
text: --you've carried all these years...

name: Arator
text: It's time to let it go.

name: Arator
text: Take it up again.

name: Arator
text: Be the paladin you were born to be.

name: Arator
text: But not all of you.

name: Arator
text: Don't give up hope, father.

name: Arator
text: A notebook? So many pages missing... strange. Let's get to Umbric. He'll want to know.

name: Arator
text: They shouldn't be a problem much longer.

name: Arator
text: It was no trouble at all.

name: Arator
text: There we are--keep him close now!

name: Arator
text: What happened here?

name: Arator
text: Thank you, Dezco. I really admire what you're doing here. I'll be sure to return.

name: Arator
text: The Lightbloom first appeared when the Sunwell was restored, many years ago. But it never grew near civilization like this.

name: Arator
text: Perhaps this sudden growth is tied to the empowerment of the Sunwell. I think I was right--this could be used to help the Vanguard.

name: Arator
text: The nearest Lightbloom is nowhere near the village. How did the growth get all the way out here?

name: Arator
text: A lack of Farstriders seems very convenient for our murderer.

name: Arator
text: I forgot that statue was here.

name: Arator
text: So that is why the Scarlet Crusade claims it acts according to the Light's will.

name: Arator
text: The Light will prevail. We must have faith.

name: Arator
text: I had expected these relics to be powerful weapons.

name: Arator
text: Instead, they were mostly simple items, unconnected to war.

name: Arator
text: The Silver Hand was founded to wield the Light in battle. Is that not the measure of a paladin's accomplishments?

name: Arator
text: Seems like Lord Antenorian is offering everyone refuge.

name: Arator
text: This is my father's shield, isn't it? How did it break?

name: Arator
text: I'll ask around and see if I can find any leads.

name: Arator
text: I had no idea. I didn't realize what my father went through.

name: Arator
text: I think... I think I'd like to fix this shield, and return it to him.

name: Arator
text: $n, please join me at the forge. I'll need your help with the shield.

name: Arator
text: Let's do this! I'll hammer, you control the heat!

name: Arator
text: Add some wyrmdust to make it more powerful.

name: Arator
text: I need another steel ingot.

name: Arator
text: Add a phoenix feather to increase the heat.

name: Arator
text: Stop! The temperature isn't right. Let's start over. Tell me when you're ready.

name: Arator
text: I did. He said "some things can't ever be redeemed" and refused it.

name: Arator
text: So did I... but a wise man once told me "I can't change anything but how I feel."

name: Arator
text: So I'm going to focus on that. My father may not be ready to change, but I am.

name: Arator
text: I just need to figure out what to do with this shield.

name: Arator
text: Where is this place? It doesn't appear to be in Azeroth.

name: Arator
text: If I repair the shield, maybe it can remind my father of the kind of paladin he wanted to be.

name: Arator
text: It does feel right.

name: Arator
text: The Dark Horde is stuck reliving the Second War, just like the Sons of Lothar.

name: Arator
text: I'll do it. Faol told me that the Silver Hand was meant to protect the defenseless, during war as well as peace.

name: Arator
text: Maybe I can help to demonstrate that service to others, as Dezco has. This reforged shield can be a reminder to me, as I protect Azeroth.

name: Arator
text: Thank you. All of you. I won't let you down.

name: Arator
text: I was going to hang up the shield. Instead, I will wield it. I want to protect the people of Azeroth.

name: Arator
text: Thank you for helping me, $n. I think that our presence has been missed in Silvermoon. We should return.

name: Arator
text: Orweyna... what was that thing?

name: Arator
text: $p, where's Hieron? Is he...?

name: Arator
text: A cult? ...could it be the Twilight's Blade, here?

name: Arator
text: Too many people are dodging questions... There may be something darker going on here.

name: Arator
text: All right... But if this lesson is anything like the others--

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: The Vanguard of the Light will need quarters and supplies.

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: No! We need to focus on launching a counterattack!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: You have your orders!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Move out!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Investigate if you must, Arator. But I expect you at the pass in short order.

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Our forces are scattered. The Devouring Host will overwhelm us!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: $n, find Arator! I will rally the Vanguard and prepare an assault!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: We must strike back while we have the chance!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: (sighs)

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Vanguard of the Light, form a line! Hold this gate!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Arator! You broke formation.

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: On that we agree. Arator, hold the line. $p, seize those weapons!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Vanguard of the Light! With me! Push these invaders back to the Void that spawned them!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Damn it all! Vanguard, fall back!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Xal'atath! Today, the Light will prevail once and for all!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Wretched Amani! By the Light, I will see these monsters purged!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Channel the Light from the weapons you recovered! Drive this monster back to the Void!

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Arator, you may be needed at the Sunwell.

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: General, perhaps you could see to our forces at the Sunwell. I will discuss matters with the Regent Lord.

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: My son...

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Arator, I...

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: I was hoping to...

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: That we could--

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Could you ever forgive me?

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: My... my shield.

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: How? How did you--

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: (sighs) I can't.

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: That part of me died with Lothar.

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: My son, some things...

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: ...can't ever be redeemed.

name: High Exarch Turalyon
text: Lor'themar could have handled the evacuation, Arator. You're needed with the Vanguard!

name: Zul'jarra
text: And I swear if you do somethin' stupid while I go to Nalorakk, I'll cut off your head myself.

name: Zul'jarra
text: No! I will not repeat your mistakes, grandfather! Even if it ruins our "family pride."

name: Zul'jarra
text: We are both Amani enough, brother. We only need to give each other more grace.

name: Zul'jarra
text: De Twilight's Blade pushed de gnarldin into our territory. We will have to fight through dem to get to de temple.

name: Zul'jarra
text: De Amani have been ignorin' de Witherbark's calls for help for too long. That ends now.

name: Zul'jarra
text: We climbed to de temple. Zul'jan fell. I did not get de loa's blessin'. And my mother died.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Kinduru... I hope you are right. For de Amani!

name: Zul'jarra
text: Let me face whatever shame still hidin' in my spirit.

name: Zul'jarra
text: No. An elf in Zul'Aman is an elf with a blade in her back. You come with me. Jan, keep an eye on her friend.

name: Zul'jarra
text: You have my thanks, $n. Gokinye or no, de Amani will greet you with honor in our lands.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Haven't been back to de temple since I was a child. There be nothin' there but birds an' bramble.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Then we be left with few warriors, few weapons, and few shamans as well...

name: Zul'jarra
text: Yes, gokinye. We are closer to achievin' your goals. Let's go.

name: Zul'jarra
text: No point in talkin' about de loa. Dey abandoned us long ago. Come. Let us check on de refugees.

name: Zul'jarra
text: What took you so long, eh? De loa will not fight me without you.

name: Zul'jarra
text: If I share my feelings, you gonna tell me how to rid myself of de hot rage and cold shame at what Akil'zon told us?

name: Zul'jarra
text: I wonder who de next one will be...

name: Zul'jarra
text: Now you try to flatter me? I know why you here. To protect your precious golden fields of Eversong.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Do not pretend to care about me or de Amani.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Mado'ru, Jan'alai. I have learned much of myself from your trials. And hope to learn more in de trials ahead.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Great Loa. You helped us get this far. But it must be us dat end this fight for good.

name: Zul'jarra
text: We will mourn their loss. But now we should celebrate what dey have given us.

name: Zul'jarra
text: As de "hash'ey?" I'm no priestess. No mystic or uniter.

name: Zul'jarra
text: We can end de threat inside and outside our gates. If you really want to join our fight, then come with me.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Ha ha ha ha ha. You're a funny one. Straight as a spear but thick as a pango-hide shield.

name: Zul'jarra
text: If you say that's what guides your hand, I believe you. Your counsel has been good. And you bring strong company.

name: Zul'jarra
text: But dat don't make us friends.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Dis journey gonna try us all, so we should get goin' soon, eh hash'ura?

name: Zul'jarra
text: When de wardrums sound, reinforcements will rally at de center altar, Jan.

name: Zul'jarra
text: What is dis, elf? You become my hash'ura and you think you can ask me personal questions now?

name: Zul'jarra
text: Now dat I have Nalorakk's blessing--and Burden--we can rally my people and end Mor'duun for good!

name: Zul'jarra
text: Fool elf, I told you de loa be silent! If you need proof, let de old loa speaker tell you himself!

name: Zul'jarra
text: I am fine. I feel as if a weight has been lifted from me. But another's takin' its place.

name: Zul'jarra
text: I am glad to gain Halazzi's favor, but bein' here brings me shame.

name: Zul'jarra
text: De Witherbark needed my help. And I did not listen. I was too worried about my own people.

name: Zul'jarra
text: We needed our warriors to protect de city. Who else gonna help us, Jan?

name: Zul'jarra
text: De trial... Kinduru brought me here as a child... I remember!

name: Zul'jarra
text: Lightwood or no, our people need rescuin', Jan. Take de elf and look for survivors.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Maybe. Akil'zon tested my conviction. And Halazzi forced me to use my head and not my fist.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Dey left 'cause we almost killed dem--our grandfather and dat villain Malacrass.

name: Zul'jarra
text: I don't mean to yell at you. I understand where you comin' from. Our image of our grandfather is hard to let go.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Proud? Of me? Hmph. I would like to say your words mean nothin'.

name: Zul'jarra
text: But as you are one of my hash'ura, I... thank you for your words.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Dis must be de fire Lilaju spoke of.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Are you saying I should feel sorry for him? Dat he should be pardoned because he had big feelings?

name: Zul'jarra
text: Sit and we will start de ritual--but be ready. Dis is de Loa of War. What ever he dreams of, we must complete de trial.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Hmph. You have again given me good counsel. And perhaps we are more alike than we seem.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Come with me. De leaders of de forest tribes have gathered to discuss our war plan.

name: Zul'jarra
text: De Witherbark loa speakers are dead. But maybe Kul'amara can help.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Heh. I know all 'bout "eccentric" loa speakers. Thank you, Vun'zarah. Maybe dis trial will be easier.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Ah, so de hash'ura did find you, my brother. Why did you miss de party? I know you like to dance!

name: Zul'jarra
text: Grah! Help!

name: Zul'jarra
text: Why, Zul'jan? Are you not happy for our victory? For de loa returnin'? For your sister becomin' hash'ey?

name: Zul'jarra
text: You do not like that the loa are back. Why, Zul'jan? They have been part of our culture since de beginnin'.

name: Zul'jarra
text: De other tribes did not heed our drums. Why?

name: Zul'jarra
text: It is neither! Can you not understand dat our relationship with de loa is built on trust, not power?

name: Zul'jarra
text: Zul'jan also be de grandchild of Zul'jin, and so he has power. And he talks well. He has followers.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Most of dem are dead because of Mor'duun. De rest? I don't want to splinter de tribe again by punishin' my brother.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Losin' his followers and seein' me become hash'ey... I think dat may be punishment enough.

name: Zul'jarra
text: We'll get your warriors back an' find de way to de Temple of Halazzi.

name: Zul'jarra
text: We are brother and sister. We "begrudge" everything. But we also leave it behind.

name: Zul'jarra
text: De way he is. It is also my fault. I should not have been so hard on him--now and as a child.

name: Zul'jarra
text: While in de crypt, I noticed de Vilebranch were blinded by de mist too. Hmm.

name: Zul'jarra
text: You want me to take his head or what? Dat's de kind of justice we have in Zul'Aman.

name: Zul'jarra
text: I know my brother. And I am goin' to give him a chance to make things right. He deserves dat from me.

name: Zul'jarra
text: We have no time to worry about Zul'jan. Our focus must be on Nalorakk. Let's go.

name: Zul'jarra
text: And how many warriors did you sacrifice to take this lightwood back from de cult?

name: Zul'jarra
text: Twilight's Blade be hidin' out at Speaker's Rest. Show them how a hash'ura protects Zul'Aman!

name: Zul'jarra
text: And they are dead just de same, Jan!

name: Zul'jarra
text: Vengeance for Atal'Aman! Remind these invaders dis land is ours!

name: Zul'jarra
text: You got dem handled, $n. Now there be fewer Twilight left in our lands thanks to you.

name: Zul'jarra
text: De last trial is all we have left. Or is it? What makes a hash'ey? Will I be able to help my people?

name: Zul'jarra
text: Torundo, hold here until Zul'jan fires, den leave with de survivors in de confusion.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Dis was no victory. We bought de civilians' escape with blood.

name: Zul'jarra
text: With de blessin' of de loa, we will rid Zul'Aman of de Twilight's Blade. For de Amani!

name: Zul'jarra
text: On my life, Lilaju. With Nalorakk's blessin', I will rid Zul'Aman of all dat threaten us.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Attitude? You don't think Nalorakk will take kindly to me walkin' up and threatenin' him with my axe?

name: Zul'jarra
text: With me, elf. Let's get in close and distract him.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Ha ha ha! Thank you, Liadrin. I do not think I would have made it dis far without you. Without both my hash'ura.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Yes. Dat my grandfather's rage made him betray de loa, try to take their power, and cut us off from our gods!

name: Zul'jarra
text: Dat means we are close. Do you feel like we bein' watched?

name: Zul'jarra
text: Get behind me!

name: Zul'jarra
text: I'll give you cover!

name: Zul'jarra
text: De tribes have splintered since Zul'jin fell. De Twilight Blade pickin' us apart because we no longer work as one.

name: Zul'jarra
text: You mean you were saved from de Vilebranch by de mist? Not lost in it?

name: Zul'jarra
text: Torundo, I need ya report. When can our soldiers be ready for battle?

name: Zul'jarra
text: For your own safety, I suggest you keep your blade sheathed and stay close to me in Amani'Zar.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Atal'Aman has fallen.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Weak child! You accept help because you fear standin' alone!

name: Zul'jarra
text: No time for barin' our tusks. We need a plan. Torundo?

name: Zul'jarra
text: I ask again for your assistance. We've got to make a stand.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Make ready what you can.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Let dem through. That $c wears de blood of our enemies.

name: Zul'jarra
text: He has been ignorin' his big sister since de day he was born.

name: Zul'jarra
text: How about a mortal blessed by four of dem?

name: Zul'jarra
text: No. Acceptin' help has strengthened us. My pride will not be de downfall of my people.

name: Zul'jarra
text: The end. Finally.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Kinduru wanted us to leave an offering. De heads of our enemies will do nicely.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Keep it up. These weapons are our best chance against de Void.

name: Zul'jarra
text: If de lightwood weapons are not ready, maybe de Shadowpine shamans can help.

name: Zul'jarra
text: We push forward. De hash'ey shrines will lead us to de Temple of Halazzi.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Warriors, you are relieved. Go be with your families. We will care for de dead.

name: Zul'jarra
text: De eagles be flying towards de temple at the top of de mountain. Maybe dat is an invitation.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Then you will help us track an' kill Mor'duun an' de Twilight's Blade, master of de hunt?

name: Zul'jarra
text: Uncle, de loa haven't spoken to you in years. Why you think dey will speak to us now?

name: Zul'jarra
text: De temple be overrun with gnarldin. Killin' dem will help us pass de time on de way. Come, "hash'ura."

name: Zul'jarra
text: Your border? Hah. If you want to die in Zul'Aman to de Twilight's Blade, I won't stop you--but your army stays here.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Yes, uncle. But even den de loa did not speak to us.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Let's see what de flames make of my spirit.

name: Zul'jarra
text: He speaks madness but seems deeply attuned to de loa. Take de coal, $n, and see if we can start de trial.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Den we must strike dem down.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Watch yaself, loa speaker!

name: Zul'jarra
text: De loa have given me power. But still, de thrill of battle is what fills my heart!

name: Zul'jarra
text: Meet me at de shrine. I will take de coal. My spirit's ready for any challenge.

name: Zul'jarra
text: Then let's see which of us feels de thrill more, elf!

name: Zul'jarra
text: So many dead... What have you done, Jan?

name: Zul'jarra
text: We need to take de fight to Mor'duun. Let's go.

name: Prophet Velen
text: I know you are tired. It is hard to continue, but we must!

name: Prophet Velen
text: Should the Sunwell fall, we have no way to stop the Devouring Host!

name: Prophet Velen
text: We have taken different paths to reach the Light, but together we assemble for the same purpose. To protect Azeroth!

name: Prophet Velen
text: The Sunwell is a conduit for the Light! Made holy through the sacrifice of the naaru Mu'ru!

name: Prophet Velen
text: Thank you, $n. We are resolute in our defense, but mortal in our constitutions. These relics will bolster us for a time.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: We can split up to cover more ground. $n and I will--

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Rage is a powerful emotion. My people were once consumed by it as well.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: If Kinduru is correct, it may be possible to contact the loa--by walking this path of "hash'ey."

name: Lady Liadrin
text: You seem... pensive, Zul'jarra. Are you not relieved Akil'zon graced us with her favor?

name: Lady Liadrin
text: And be one step closer to ridding Zul'Aman of the Twilight's Blade.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Wait... I did not mean to... Zul'jarra, becoming the hash'ey will be a great achievement.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Enough, Zul'jarra. I admit that my past keeps me from... empathizing fully with your people.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: I told you that I fought against your grandfather.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: But I did not tell you that he held me captive and tortured me. And tortured and killed many of my peers.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: And, as strange as it seems, I see some of myself in your plight. And want you to become closer to your gods.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Now! $n and I are your hash'ura. We will attend you...

name: Lady Liadrin
text: That part of my past led me down a path I am not proud of.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: We desperately need your aid. Seek me out and the Light will bear you to Quel'Danas.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: A hash'ey shrine. Like those we lit near the Temple of Akil'zon.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Are you sure your brother will follow your orders?

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Watching you go through Jan'alai's trial was unsettling. Are you well?

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Why? We rescued the Witherbark. You found the hash'ey shrines. And you are now closer to becoming hash'ey.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Luckily, Halazzi could not help but meddle in Witherbark affairs despite what your grandfather had done.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: I... cannot say. I do not know.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: It sounds like your faith in the loa is strengthening.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: You had scant resources. I cannot say I would not have protected my home over others threatened with violence.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: I have been in your situation. And like your grandfather, I wanted power and took it without caring who I hurt.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: But spiritual journeys, taken in earnest, are worthwhile whether they result in success or failure.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: These invaders are not protected by Zul'jarra. They forfeited that right by invading. Give them no ground!

name: Lady Liadrin
text: I am proud to see you not making the mistakes that I or your grandfather made, and that I am part of your journey.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: A shame that force was necessary. Words cannot solve every problem.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: $p, Xal'atath and her Devouring Host lay siege to the Sunwell. The Light has chosen you to defend it.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: I have the Light. Coming to it with a sense of entitlement--that was my mistake.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: But when I came to the Light in my darkest hour with good intentions, the Light was there for me.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: The Light has brought you back to us. Careful not to stray too far into the Void.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: It is dangerous to wander unprotected through the depths of the Void.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Stay near the Light. The Void will consume you.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Your motivations are good. Now, if you could work on your attitude.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Perhaps. But I do not think he would like to be formally greeted by an uppity, "gokinye" elf either.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Even with reinforcements, we cannot hold back the Devouring Host for long. Make haste, $p.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Some must remain to guard the Sunwell! If it falls, all is lost!

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Let us make haste for the Sanctum of Light.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: This report may evoke... skepticism in Lor'themar. Best you're with me when he hears it.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Did he just... hand you that fiery coal with his bare hands?

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Your brother has disobeyed your orders more than once. I know he is family, but should he not bear some consequences?

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Your people's situation is far more desperate than I realized.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Over here, $n! The situation is... escalating.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Still, the eagles returning here seems like a good sign.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: I will stay here with Brek. Just in case he begins to make sense. Or decides to wander off.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: The battlefield is quiet. Your warriors must have finished off the remaining Twilight's Blade.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Knights, stay and guard Eversong. Let us follow them, $n.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: The gnarldin are close to destroying the shrines. And the nests of the eagles that roost here.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Spoken like a typical Amani. But... I would be lying to say I don't feel the same.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: We cannot allow these ethereals to pillage our sacred artifacts!

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Thank the Light! You've recovered the artifacts.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Turalyon! We must regroup at the Sunwell before it's too late!

name: Lady Liadrin
text: You are the last of the Vanguard to make it.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Arator, $p! Defend us as we perform the ritual!

name: Lady Liadrin
text: There is no need for further bloodshed. Cease your raids, surrender the lightwood, and return to your lands.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: It is time for desperate acts. Would you let your people perish because you did not try every option?

name: Lady Liadrin
text: A void beast! Look out!

name: Lady Liadrin
text: The Farstriders left to investigate that noise. Suncrown had no defenders.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: If we help eliminate the Twilight's Blade, the need for lightwood, and the raids into Eversong, will end.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: The Light answered, Vandellor. I did not falter, and it answered.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: But my hands still shake with fear, my mind still clouds with doubt.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: I do not question if you would be proud of me. If you would see the blood which stains my hands.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: You taught me better than that. From your lessons I have learned to live.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: But a scar that has healed over is still a scar.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Galell... I hope you have found the peace you could not achieve in life.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: I carry both of you with me into the next dawn. Whatever form it takes.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: All or none.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Do not let it prey on your doubts!

name: Lady Liadrin
text: By the Light...

name: Lady Liadrin
text: It is as if the wilds themselves devoured this place.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: I'll finish up here with the survivors.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: I was consumed by rage at Zul'jin for what he did and sought retribution against him for years.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Zul'jin, I realized, was the same. He had good reason for his rage. And it festered and controlled him.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: No. I'm saying there is a lesson to be learned. Let go of your rage at the loa and at Zul'jin. It will lead you off your path.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Your brother would begrudge your relationship with the loa?

name: Lady Liadrin
text: He is his own man. And smart enough to know and face the consequences of his actions.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: It is too late, Arator. But we can heal those in need.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: About your grandfather, Zul'jin?

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Forgive me...

name: Lady Liadrin
text: But what about the loa? Can you not call upon them to aid you?

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Zul'jarra, I see that something is burdening you. I genuinely want to help.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Allow us passage into Zul'Aman! We cannot sit idle while the Twilight amass close to our border!

name: Lady Liadrin
text: What do we do now? This mist is... impenetrable.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: We prayed for a miracle, and the Vanguard of Light answered the call. But the battle yet rages on.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Now that the shrines are lit, the eagles are on the move.

name: Lady Liadrin
text: Wait, Zul'jarra! Are you mad?

name: Lady Liadrin
text: I can help you if you allow it, Zul'jarra. Find me once you have finished your mission, $n.

name: Orweyna
text: The rutaani... they are being driven to grow. This Light you speak of may be the cause.

name: Orweyna
text: Magistrix, when did you first begin seeing these disturbances with this Lightbloom?

name: Orweyna
text: The Den has been ravaged with vermin. If we deal with that problem the elders will be more favorable with us. Take a grymlinx--they are always up for a meal.

name: Orweyna
text: This Lightbloom you describe is clearly out of control. We must find what has disturbed it so.

name: Orweyna
text: One full belly, and a few pleased elders. Well done my friend.

name: Orweyna
text: The creatures... they remind me of home, yet they live on the surface. It should not be this way.

name: Orweyna
text: They claimed this as their territory. We are now encroaching.

name: Orweyna
text: $p, we must discover what caused these creatures to flourish so suddenly.

name: Orweyna
text: A rutaani. Creatures from my homeland. They should not be here.

name: Orweyna
text: This is wrong. All wrong.

name: Orweyna
text: $n, Halduron--we must defend Har'mara!

name: Orweyna
text: The madness has overtaken the roots. We must stop it here.

name: Orweyna
text: I can feel him fleeing through the roots. We have to--

name: Orweyna
text: The elders must hear of this. Go with the wind!

name: Orweyna
text: With Ruia in retreat and Alndust in hand, we can drive the frenzy back.

name: Orweyna
text: I can hear the voice of the goddess now, but only as a whisper. How do the Shul'ka endure this emptiness?

name: Orweyna
text: Without the Alndust, we face a grim task. Steel yourself.

name: Orweyna
text: We used the last of the Alndust we gathered. What do you intend to do, Halduron?

name: Orweyna
text: The elders will not sacrifice any of the Alndust. We must find another way.

name: Orweyna
text: If you detonate your runestones, your forests will burn.

name: Orweyna
text: Rootwarden Ruia? What is this madness?

name: Orweyna
text: They are relentless! Aln'hara, give me strength!

name: Orweyna
text: Elder Hagar?

name: Orweyna
text: Aln'hara's blessing empowers us. Today, we fight for all of her creation!

name: Orweyna
text: Show no fear. Ruia is powerful, but he stands alone. This ends here.

name: Orweyna
text: Ruia! The will of Aln'hara stands against you! Cease this madness!

name: Orweyna
text: Alndust--remnants of the goddess's will, given form. It empowers our magics and allows us to walk between worlds.

name: Orweyna
text: I know, but neither does it change the past.

name: Orweyna
text: It is made possible by the Alndust. One of the many reasons it is so sacred to us.

name: Orweyna
text: Thank you, $n. You helped bring my people back into the world. The goddess would be pleased, I think.

name: Orweyna
text: We have solved nothing. These rutaani have been changed. I must return to Harandar and investigate.

name: Orweyna
text: Alndust... The elders will not part with it easily. Still, we have to try.

name: Orweyna
text: I'm ready to perform the Shul'ka's ritual. It will protect us when we enter the Rift of Aln... for a time.

name: Orweyna
text: I sense her call within the creature. It is born of Aln'hara! It could never hurt me!

name: Orweyna
text: We would not have made it here without you.

name: Orweyna
text: Distribute the Alndust to the warriors here. It will empower them to strike back against the Lightbloom.

name: Orweyna
text: Could we not gather dust from easier prey?

name: Orweyna
text: This way, Halduron, $n.

name: Orweyna
text: That doesn't matter now. You need help.

name: Orweyna
text: Tread carefully. You will be seen as invaders.

name: Orweyna
text: The people of the Har'athir settlement tend these roots. It is a short way down the path.

name: Orweyna
text: I warn you both: my people do not welcome outsiders. They may no longer welcome me.

name: Orweyna
text: Alndust is limited, so we must cull the areas where the Lightbloom is most active.

name: Orweyna
text: A large attack only causes the Lightbloom to spread. A few, striking the most dangerous--that is best.

name: Orweyna
text: The infested rutaani spread the Lightbloom! Where is Eonka?

name: Orweyna
text: That looks dangerous. We must destroy it before they finish infusing it.

name: Orweyna
text: Behold, Harandar.

name: Orweyna
text: $n will find them. We must get you to safety.

name: Orweyna
text: So this is where Ruia has hidden himself...

name: Orweyna
text: Ruia is here?

name: Orweyna
text: I will block the Rootways. He will not escape again.

name: Orweyna
text: Striking at individual blooms is not enough. We'll need to take drastic action.

name: Orweyna
text: His faith in the goddess has become hatred. Is this what Lightbloom does?

name: Orweyna
text: These can take us below, but swiftly. I would not expose them to the Lightbloom long.

name: Orweyna
text: Enough of this.

name: Orweyna
text: Show yourselves.

name: Orweyna
text: I came here to speak.

name: Orweyna
text: Out of respect.

name: Orweyna
text: A precision attack? I should have called for everyone.

name: Orweyna
text: The Lightbloom is persistent--we too must be.

name: Orweyna
text: But if violence is your intent...

name: Orweyna
text: They hear the goddess's song as we do!

name: Orweyna
text: They fight to save her!

name: Orweyna
text: Is that NOT who WE are anymore?

name: Orweyna
text: Will you do nothing but skulk in these caves lamenting the withered past?

name: Orweyna
text: (gasps)

name: Orweyna
text: Goddess?

name: Orweyna
text: Follow me!

name: Orweyna
text: I HEAR her voice!

name: Orweyna
text: To think that Eversong's Light would wreak such havoc in Harandar.

name: Orweyna
text: Should I not follow wherever it leads?

name: Orweyna
text: Harandar is a dangerous place.

name: Orweyna
text: The attack is letting up. Good work!

name: Orweyna
text: Ask around the Den. Glean what wisdom you can.

name: Orweyna
text: Her voice is gone. I have never felt so alone. Is this Amarakk's life?

name: Orweyna
text: This ritual only imitates the Shul'ka's sacrifice. It is neither permanent nor perfect. We must hurry and find Amarakk.

name: Orweyna
text: He's not here. The ward... I need more Alndust, $n. Hurry.

name: Orweyna
text: I drift along a cloud of sound, my friend. She comforts me. She welcomes me. I--

name: Orweyna
text: The Lightbloom kills, then grows anew. A vicious cycle that cannot be allowed to continue.

name: Orweyna
text: It seems even your runestones cannot stop the Lightbloom surge, if there are none left to defend them.

name: Orweyna
text: The growth of these plants has been forced. By what, I do not know.

name: Orweyna
text: NO! The goddess! She--she... Amarakk? $n?

name: Orweyna
text: On'hiea? Please!

name: Orweyna
text: Follow the trail. It should lead to the answers we seek.

name: Orweyna
text: Thank you Amarakk. I owe you more than I can say.

name: Orweyna
text: Here in Har'mara, you will see a rare glimpse of the rutaani and fungarians at peace.

name: Orweyna
text: With Aln'hara's grace, the Alndust will protect these Rutaani as it did Eonka.

name: Orweyna
text: It works! At last, we have a way to fight back.

name: Orweyna
text: A rutaani, here? What is that it holds?

name: Orweyna
text: We will remain here to guard Hagar and the others.

name: Orweyna
text: Alndust. Perhaps that is what shielded Eonka from the Lightbloom.

name: Orweyna
text: What are you thinking? We must clear the defenses first.

name: Orweyna
text: There you are. Unfortunately our fears were well-founded.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: The fate of Silvermoon, of all of Azeroth, may rest on the outcome of this mission. Anu belore dela'na.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: I will consider it, after I have consulted with the others.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: You have already taken so many of my Blood Knights to empower the Sunwell! Quel'Thalas is largely undefended!

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: The Sunwell must not fall.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: The Amani Pass takes priority. I will not let them invade Quel'Thalas again.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: With the Lightbloom contained, we have one less battlefront. We can focus on Xal'atath's forces.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: $n, return to the Sanctum of Light. This struggle is far from over.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Orweyna, your efforts saved Eversong this day. The haranir will always have a place in Silvermoon, should they wish it.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: No! I will not leave my people undefended!

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: The Twilight's Blade had sensitive information. Not just about Tranquillien, but all of Quel'Thalas.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Silvermoon is restless enough with the storm overhead. I won't give my people another reason to panic.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: I trust you will do what needs to be done.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Arator, $p! The evacuating ships are under attack!

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: If we don't protect those ships, we'll have sent the people aboard them to die!

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Turalyon forgets that victory means nothing if it costs us everything in return.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Go. Quickly--Liadrin needs urgent assistance with the Amani.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: So the crash caused the Lightbloom to surge... Thank you. Rest easy, and leave this to us.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: That tree they felled--that's what caused Suncrown's destruction! The Amani will pay for this!

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: You made the right choice--the only choice. Now we can truly begin to fight back.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: If the Twilight's Blade has any other intelligence, I want it returned or destroyed. Recover what you can. Burn the rest.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Thank you, Liadrin. I hope Halduron can tell us what's going on.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: I'll speak to the Vanguard while you get the other matters settled.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: We can't defend against both the Voidstorm and the aggression from the Lightbloom.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: The Sunwell holds for now, only through the constant effort of its defenders. Should their strength waver...

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Bishop Alonsus Faol has a plan to support those at the Sunwell. And to help Arator.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: You're needed in Fairbreeze, champion. A problem with the Lightbloom.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Champion, you've uncovered many threats that besiege Quel'Thalas. We must plan our next move together.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: And young Arator has more than proven his worth. Together, I hope their Light will balance you within the shadow.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Halduron has joined your haranir friend to aid in ending the threat. They await you in Fairbreeze.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: If you will not fight, get out of my way!

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: I can protect you in the city, but the Vanguard will not allow you to approach the Sunwell. Results will change that.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Champion! We've cornered Zul'jan. It is time to bring this incursion to an end!

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Were we blind to Arator's truth?

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Lady Liadrin, secure the pass. For good or ill, we've taken a stand here. We should keep it.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: The rest of us will return to Silvermoon. There is... much to discuss.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: If you found a pathway to Xal'atath, the Vanguard would leave. To say nothing of the power your people could acquire.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Using a relic of the Void to breach the storm... It sounds risky, Umbric.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: You did what you had to, Umbric. We must enter the Voidstorm if we are to stop it.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: High Commander Lothraxion has warred on countless far realms, so I have asked him to lead this mission.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: $p? Thank the Light. With the storm breaking, we just might win this.

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: Evacuating the civilians must take priority!

name: Lor'themar Theron
text: I've received reports from the Sunwell that Faol's plan has worked. The defenders hold back the Voidstorm another day.

name: Faerin Lothar
text: The Light will shield the land of my ancestors!

name: Faerin Lothar
text: Thank you, Anduin. May the Sacred Flame preserve us all.

name: Magister Umbric
text: The Terrace holds what we require to gain entry to the Voidstorm... the Cynosure of Twilight.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Of course he left a message for me. I'm afraid you'll have to incapacitate the guards.

name: Magister Umbric
text: I've a few items I'd like to pick up while we're here. I'll meet you at the exit.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Oh, and beware of the librarians. Knowledge tends to... pack a punch in these halls.

name: Magister Umbric
text: One of my own, dead? How could this happen?

name: Magister Umbric
text: This map of Eversong is marked with targets for the Twilight's Blade--including Windrunner Village!

name: Magister Umbric
text: How I've missed this library. But we can't afford to linger here.

name: Magister Umbric
text: The Void feels... honed here. Perhaps the work of Decimus?

name: Magister Umbric
text: To think Rommath would go this far to keep me out...

name: Magister Umbric
text: I seem to be... detained. The construct ahead is heightening Rommath's spellwork. Destroy it.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Antenorian was two steps ahead the entire time I was here. Let's return to my study.

name: Magister Umbric
text: We've rescued who we can, but my research...

name: Magister Umbric
text: What was in that lockbox?

name: Magister Umbric
text: A crude solution, but effective. The Cynosure should be just ahead.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Seranel! Stand down! I have permission from Lor'themar himself!

name: Magister Umbric
text: Restrain him! I'll take care of these shields.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Help me remove the wards around the Cynosure!

name: Magister Umbric
text: Something's gone terribly wrong... Go. I'll catch up once I find a way to fix this.

name: Magister Umbric
text: $p, I know what to do! I'll need to attune the Cynosure to the Voidstorm.

name: Magister Umbric
text: What... is that monstrosity? $p, you keep it occupied while I channel the spell and end this chaos!

name: Magister Umbric
text: It is done! We have our way into the Voidstorm. Let us inform Lor'themar.

name: Magister Umbric
text: ...and perhaps offer an apology for the near catastrophe.

name: Magister Umbric
text: This is a member of the Twilight's Blade. You were right, Arator--quickly, back to Tranquillien!

name: Magister Umbric
text: This is the most stable place for a portal, but Decimus's beast is in the way.

name: Magister Umbric
text: So much--so much Void!

name: Magister Umbric
text: I'm going to try to decipher Kasiea's notes one last time. They may be the key to unraveling the Voidstorm.

name: Magister Umbric
text: $n! Bring those Void shards to the center portal. If I'm right, it should reverse the path and open the way to the Voidstorm.

name: Magister Umbric
text: These cultists have transitioned from elemental to void magic. Collect samples so we can understand their methods.

name: Magister Umbric
text: These notes... Kasiea? No!

name: Magister Umbric
text: Fascinating. And terrifying. Thank you, champion. I look forward to understanding their methods more.

name: Magister Umbric
text: The remnants of the Twilight's Hammer are smuggling in void-infused supplies. See that they do not arrive.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Good work. Keeping them from rearming will keep them on the run.

name: Magister Umbric
text: No! We were so close...

name: Magister Umbric
text: These cultists want a firefight? We can oblige them! Destroy their incendiary stockpiles and drive them away.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Drakgor may be gone, but you have honored its memory today, $n.

name: Magister Umbric
text: I need to look into Kasiea's notes. I won't let her die in vain.

name: Magister Umbric
text: My research on the Voidstorm--the Twilight's Blade has stolen it all!

name: Magister Umbric
text: Excellent--wait, what's that glinting over there?

name: Magister Umbric
text: See to the citizens. I'll find Antenorian... and make him pay.

name: Magister Umbric
text: These notes have to hold the answer! Kasiea... I'll make sure you didn't die in vain. Arator, tell Lor'themar he has my aid.

name: Magister Umbric
text: I'll be in touch the moment I have a solution.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Lord Antenorian values nothing more than the safety of his people. He'll want to know about this.

name: Magister Umbric
text: It's calm for now... but if the Twilight's Blade had a map of the area, it may not last.

name: Magister Umbric
text: One of the Void samples! See if the others are here.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Resist it, $p! You control the Shadow, it does not control you!

name: Magister Umbric
text: Even if I offered my aid to Silvermoon, I have little to give, now.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Results? I have no tools, no support, and zealots on both sides hunting me...

name: Magister Umbric
text: Go on, $n. Tell him.

name: Magister Umbric
text: The cult continues to recruit the innocent with promises of power. Their evil ends now.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Hopefully more learn the lesson you have given the cult today.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Kasiea's notes appear to be focused on... summoning? Let's see.

name: Magister Umbric
text: A rift!

name: Magister Umbric
text: $p, I found a way into the storm, but getting there will be... difficult.

name: Magister Umbric
text: A sample of Void energy. Good. Let's take it and try another location.

name: Magister Umbric
text: It's been too long since I've seen these walls.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Kasiea's research holds the first steps I need to help Silvermoon. Antenorian took those missing pages. I'd bet my life on it.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Here $p, help me align the spell. It will anchor us back to Magisters' Terrace in case of disaster.

name: Magister Umbric
text: I trust you, $n. Find Antenorian, get the information we need, and take him down.

name: Magister Umbric
text: The portal is opened. Gather your courage... only darkness awaits us on the other side.

name: Magister Umbric
text: This place is more exposed to the Voidstorm. Things may get dangerous.

name: Magister Umbric
text: More creatures!

name: Magister Umbric
text: Was she summoning from the Voidstorm itself? But why?

name: Magister Umbric
text: Let's try the last location.

name: Magister Umbric
text: Kasiea... what were you doing?

name: Magister Umbric
text: It's working! Look at the size of that thing!

name: Magister Umbric
text: That's our last sample. What was the purpose of all of this?

name: Magister Umbric
text: Let's take these back to my study.

name: Magister Umbric
text: The Twilight's Blade have returned to mine the Elementium Depths. Do not let them keep what they find!

name: Magister Umbric
text: Perhaps we can repurpose these materials. I'll pass them along.

name: Magister Umbric
text: That isn't your decision to make!

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Won't see me coming.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Watch your back.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Let's dance.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Knives out.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I'll handle the lock. You deal with the trap.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: No clicks, no clouds of poison--nicely done. Let's see what's inside.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Not quick enough.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: You've got skills, $n. I look forward to working with you again.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: If these papers were lost, the Regent Lord's headache would've lasted a lifetime.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I'll take that.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Your life is mine.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Your pain, my pleasure.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Tsk tsk. Pesky magic.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I'll take that.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Let me get rid of that.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Be quiet.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Speak no more.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I don't think so.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: One moment.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: That's much better.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I earned this.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I'll be more helpful now.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Still with me?

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Daydreaming, I see.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I'll savor this strike.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: You can handle this now.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Now strike!

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Let's not waste time.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Curse it all!

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I'm out...

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I can't... I'm sorry...

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Thank you.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Plenty to do.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Let's keep moving.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: My eye's on you.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: All in all, an easy rescue. But there are others in worse straits still hidden away.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: A clean death. More than he deserved.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Be quicker next time.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: What we did here hurt them. Hopefully it will send more fleeing from their ranks.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: The Twilight's Blade will gladly prey on anyone, no matter what faction they hail from.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Thank you for your aid. Until next time, $n.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: There's gold here.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Need any gold? ...Should I even ask?

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I won't let them rot.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: More than one way to skin a beast.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: This beast has value after all.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Good. Take its skin.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I'm guessing Lor'themar needs something done in secret. Never forget that the sun casts the deepest shadows.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: This must be the heart of their spy network.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Of course--the Reliquary will lend aid wherever it's needed. Let me know if you're interested as well.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: $p. Lor'themar sent me to help with that rat you're chasing.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Well isn't this discreet. So what's the mission, Regent Lord?

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: My kind of mission.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: They've built themselves a little fortress...

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I've seen enough. These captives walk free today. Their tormentors do not.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Chains are off. Move fast and don't look back.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: You're free now. Run while you can.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: They'll be looking for you soon. Make sure you're gone.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Enough of the cult hospitality. Time to leave.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I left the letter on the crates. Take a look.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I'll scout the path. Don't delay--timing is everything.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: The letter wasn't empty--it carried a map, leading straight into Zul'Aman.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: I'll stay in the shadows and keep eyes from above. Don't worry--if things turn, you won't be alone.

name: Valeera Sanguinar
text: Not bad, $n. Now, let's find out just how deep their claws tried to dig.

name: Eitrigg
text: The Dark Horde displays them like trophies. But the only thing they mark is loss.

name: Eitrigg
text: The Horde left behind this dark past long ago. If only everyone here had come with us.

name: Eitrigg
text: The Dark Horde will have taken the fragments, divided it up amongst themselves as a trophy.

name: Eitrigg
text: I understand, Faol. I'll gather the others and wait for your arrival.

name: Eitrigg
text: If the boy has all the fragments of the shield, we can begin.

name: Eitrigg
text: Take a look around. Horde, Alliance... this place is a refuge for those who've had enough of war.

name: Eitrigg
text: Your father refused the legacy. It's yours if you want it.

name: Eitrigg
text: The Sons of Lothar will stay here for a bit. The Arcantina needs our protection. Or at least I need another round.

name: Zul'jan
text: Zul'jarra could not see my vision, but I saw no other way. De loa? Feh.

name: Zul'jan
text: They abandoned us. They. Abandoned. Us. How do we know they won't do it again?

name: Zul'jan
text: I see your eyes are widening, "hash'ura." You're right. Forget what I have said. We have won. Zul'jarra has won.

name: Zul'jan
text: Come to point out more of my flaws, sister? Why? Afraid I'm a better Amani than you?

name: Zul'jan
text: Forgive me, sister. I do not feel like celebrating.

name: Zul'jan
text: I am glad we crushed de Twilight's Blade. And I am glad that you are happy.

name: Zul'jan
text: Forget them, sister. We have de lightwood. We need no other tribe than our Amani.

name: Zul'jan
text: Let me ask you, sister. Do you submit to de loa, or do the loa submit to you?

name: Zul'jan
text: Sacrifice? They are heroes. Heroes that fell as true Amani, reclaiming de lightwood at Atal'Aman.

name: Zul'jan
text: De blood of those who died today will become de flood that washes de invaders from our lands!

name: Zul'jan
text: Yes, but what if we become dependent on them again and they disappear? When they left, it shattered us.

name: Zul'jan
text: I... thank you, sister. I hope you are right.

name: Zul'jan
text: Sister, you return! While you were prostrating yourself before de loa, I secured real power!

name: Zul'jan
text: Get over here, $n! I'll load de bolts. You start firing.

name: Zul'jan
text: We couldn't wait any longer for your loa. If my hand forced yours, so be it!

name: Zul'jan
text: Our lands? This was all once "our lands." And everything on it!

name: Zul'jan
text: Please, uncle. We are under attack! Only take what you need and let's go!

name: Zul'jan
text: You sure you didn't pack it already?

name: Zul'jan
text: I swear to de ancestors I will throw you over my shoulder and carry you if you don't leave now.

name: Zul'jan
text: Running away? Coward. De victory should have been ours!

name: Zul'jan
text: No thanks to all of you!

name: Zul'jan
text: You will take de lightwood over my grave, gokinye. Lightwood weapons are--

name: Zul'jan
text: Warriors, attack!

name: Zul'jan
text: We never needed them. We can rely on our own strength!

name: Zul'jan
text: I will go back to de village and celebrate with my sister.

name: Zul'jan
text: You and you--take what's left of de ballista bolts to de altar.

name: Zul'jan
text: Do you see, $c? De cult burns de lightwood because they fear its power.

name: Zul'jan
text: Not if my blade sends her yours first!

name: Zul'jan
text: You would let gokinye, the invaders, fight in Atal'Aman?

name: Zul'jan
text: Lightwood. Loa. Outsiders... Even combined, an ocean of Amani blood paid for our victory.

name: Zul'jan
text: Fine. $C, take de weapons. Arm any Amani you find.

name: Zul'jan
text: I will watch their every move.

name: Zul'jan
text: We were young when our mother died. My sister held de tribes together with de force of her will--without de loa.

name: Zul'jan
text: Gokinye! Help me put this fire out--now!

name: Zul'jan
text: I could never be de warrior that Zul'jarra is. I talk my way through problems. She plows through them head on.

name: Zul'jan
text: Where were all of you when de drums sounded? You let Atal'Aman fall!

name: Zul'jan
text: We have different goals for de Amani. Zul'jarra focuses on growing and preserving de Amani tribes within Zul'Aman.

name: Zul'jan
text: Your forces are needed here, Kul'amara.

name: Zul'jan
text: I see de strength of the Amani--our tribe. We should conquer those around us! Zul'jarra doesn't understand.

name: Zul'jan
text: When Mor'duun came, I saw my vision of de Amani coming to life. With de lightwood, we would conquer de Twilight's Blade and then Eversong.

name: Zul'jan
text: Old man, de loa stopped granting us favor decades ago. And we are better off without them.

name: Zul'jan
text: De loa say our grandfather, de great Zul'jin, betrayed them. But why believe them? Or my dotterin' uncle. Or any gokinye?

name: Lothraxion
text: For the Light!

name: Lothraxion
text: Keep your weapons close. Trust nothing the Void offers.

name: Lothraxion
text: No. This... elf... has made their allegiance known.

name: Lothraxion
text: Then we will destroy them. And the ethereals will provide our ordnance.

name: Lothraxion
text: Fine. On your head be it.

name: Lothraxion
text: Ha! Kill and kill, yet no alarm is raised. They seem used to this chaos.

name: Lothraxion
text: Soon we'll have all we need. We should strike down this wretch before their hunger turns on us.

name: Lothraxion
text: Yet only I seem to understand what is at stake.

name: Lothraxion
text: What does it matter? Salvage what we need and then raze this forge to the ground. They can burn with their secrets.

name: Lothraxion
text: Burn in the Light, wretch!

name: Lothraxion
text: The Light prevails. I expect Decimus puts up even less of a fight.

name: Lothraxion
text: You willingly choose to go against the Light's will.

name: Lothraxion
text: They've taken a naaru prisoner? We cannot allow these monsters to possess a being of pure Light!

name: Lothraxion
text: Keep your distance from the naaru, voidspawn. You are unworthy to bask in its radiance!

name: Lothraxion
text: You will see.

name: Lothraxion
text: Arator, keep an eye on your mother and her smug hound. I don't want it out of the Light's presence.

name: Lothraxion
text: We need that shield down, now!

name: Lothraxion
text: You will realize I was right, Alleria.

name: Lothraxion
text: Your judgment has been clouded by the Void. As it always does!

name: Lothraxion
text: You will not stop what the Light demands!
