name: Lothraxion
text: This is taking too long. Stand aside, I'll smash the damned thing.

name: Lothraxion
text: You of them all, I thought would understand Arator.

name: Lothraxion
text: A shame that the Void has corrupted you too.

name: Lothraxion
text: You will see the Light's wrath!

name: Lothraxion
text: The Light will cleanse!

name: Lothraxion
text: Then you will tell us how to break the storm, voidspawn.

name: Lothraxion
text: I will not allow this!

name: Lothraxion
text: No! You... must...!

name: Lothraxion
text: The Light is our greatest weapon against the Void. Remember that, or succumb to corruption.

name: Lothraxion
text: Foul spawn of the Void! Prepare to meet your end!

name: Lothraxion
text: The High Exarch calls us to glory or death!

name: Lothraxion
text: Ignore it, Arator. See to Alleria. Salvaging this mission now falls to me.

name: Lothraxion
text: How could this have gone so wrong? We're no closer to bringing the forces of the Light to bear on this world.

name: Lothraxion
text: You must feel it too, $n. A waiting betrayal. I know what must be done.

name: Lothraxion
text: You've been subverting us all along! Be eradicated, Decimus!

name: Lothraxion
text: You'd follow this creature to its foul den?

name: Lothraxion
text: You are a paladin, Arator! You must see this Decimus for the monster it is!

name: Lothraxion
text: I was reforged in the Light! You are blind to the truth!

name: Lothraxion
text: Why merely shut down the Nexus-Points? We should raze them from within.

name: Lothraxion
text: Don't look so eager, beast. You've fooled Alleria, but I see through you.

name: Lothraxion
text: A creature without purpose. Like every fiend from the Void.

name: Lothraxion
text: Loyalty is so contrary to the Void that you'd betray your master out of boredom?

name: Lothraxion
text: Some of us serve greater purposes than hunger, beast.

name: Lothraxion
text: I'll hunt down Severum. You and this voidspawn can handle the trench.

name: Lothraxion
text: This beast is off its leash!

name: Lothraxion
text: A naaru, lost to us!

name: Lothraxion
text: Acceptable losses. The void elves knew the risks.

name: Lothraxion
text: Risk? You trust the word of a domanaar over mine.

name: Lothraxion
text: The Void holds allegiance to none!

name: Lothraxion
text: It corrupts and confounds, makes enemies of friends, twists right into wrong.

name: Lothraxion
text: I have served the Light for millennia. I understand sacrifice better than you ever could.

name: Lothraxion
text: We must get a lay of the land. Come!

name: Lothraxion
text: This is what Alleria wanted to protect you from, Arator. The darkness beyond.

name: Lothraxion
text: Trusting Decimus was madness!

name: Lothraxion
text: Understand, Alleria, that I lead this mission. But your aid is welcome.

name: Lothraxion
text: I knew you were blind to the Void's schemes!

name: Lothraxion
text: The time for caution has passed. We will reach their leader and rip the information we need from it!

name: Lothraxion
text: These vile monsters are no match for us, $p!

name: Lothraxion
text: Are you mad, Alleria?

name: Lothraxion
text: You intend to take it prisoner? I would rather incinerate it.

name: Lothraxion
text: War is no place for a tender heart, boy.

name: Lothraxion
text: Take down its pet, $p!

name: Lothraxion
text: No! Those Void addicts are not our salvation. The Light is the only way to stop Xal'atath's evil.

name: Lothraxion
text: No! After it!

name: Lothraxion
text: One wrong move and I will sear you with the Light, fiend.

name: Lothraxion
text: Then that is our first target. We must weaken the storm and our foes! Move out!

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: Stop the ritual! To arms! Eversong need not burn today!

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: I cannot say we have ever fought a haranir Rootwarden before. Anything we should know?

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: If these blooms take root, Har'mara will be destroyed!

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: Your people saved our home, Orweyna--and at great cost to yourselves. Your sacrifice shall not go unrecognized.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: I must insist you join me in Silvermoon.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: These paintings... I've never experienced a magic like this.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: We have rebuilt from ashes before. Without any Alndust, what other recourse do we have?

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: My skin is tingling. What IS this?

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: The lumbering beast outside? It seemed so docile... This reeks of foul play.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: My Farstriders could use a hand in Fairbreeze. See what you can do about the wildlife there.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: Orweyna has gone ahead to speak to her elders. Let me know when you're ready, $n.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: This place... It is like we've stepped back in time.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: I have to learn more of the Lightbloom, even with the risks of traveling to your homeland.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: Impressive work. Perhaps you would entertain a commission with the Farstriders?

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: Any time now, Rommath!

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: Orweyna, $n, thank goodness! Eversong is in danger!

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: This seed... It's coated in--

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: I see why they are so protective... Such untouched beauty.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: Incredible. $n, come and see.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: I have brought what help I could.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: It is strange to see friendly rutaani.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: This is getting us nowhere. Send word to Rommath. Have the Magisters make haste to the Suncrown Tree.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: Whatever I must.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: Lor'themar! I've secured the area, but they're making a push for Amani Pass.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: The Lightbloom has reached the river. Light of the sun preserve us. We are out of time.

name: Halduron Brightwing
text: I will take this seed back to Silvermoon. Perhaps the Magisters will have some insight.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Hurry, $p! We need your help against that behemoth!

name: Alonsus Faol
text: I must now steal Arator and $n away. Arrangements have been made to find one last relic.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Such a troubled boy. That'll happen when your father leaves a gaping wound in your chest. Not to worry--I have a plan.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Ah good! You're both here. There is a crisis of faith that we need to fix!

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Arator, the Light may empower its followers, but the morals and ethics of this force come from within each of us.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Hmmph. Those defenders have exhausted themselves, giving of their own faith and power. We bolster their reserves.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: But the Light cannot distinguish between love and hatred.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: To Light's Hope to gather relics and inspire the Vanguard.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: And why they were able to pervert my teachings of fellowship and protection into something you and I recognize so clearly as evil.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: However... the relics they possess will do for our purposes of bolstering the Sunwell defenders.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: It... will be good to reclaim them.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: The Scarlet Crusade was founded by a paladin I personally anointed. For a long time, I saw them as my own misjudgment made manifest. Perhaps I still do.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: For my first lesson, learn from the revered heroes of the past and what inspired their Light.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: If you'll all excuse me, I must find Eitrigg. There are some things I need to arrange.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Well, I think you're absolutely right. I really did make a mess of it all, didn't I?

name: Alonsus Faol
text: I'm reminded of each and every one of my failings every day when the Light burns me as I channel it.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: As you have guessed, that is your father's shield. Broken into fragments and left on the field of battle.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: In many ways, this world is broken. You should feel angry about it.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: That doesn't mean you can't try to change the world, or yourself, for the better.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Come with me on my little quest. I can't promise we'll change anything but how you feel.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: $p! We're going to save the Sunwell. More importantly, we're going to fix that broken young man.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Oh, don't worry. This one won't be imparted by me.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Quite the opposite. We're going to see someone who is doing something wonderful. Something I failed to accomplish.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Such a waste. And they can't even blame the dreadlord anymore.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: But that's the only thing we can control.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: The most revered paladins didn't draw their faith in the Light from warfare. They fought to preserve what they valued most.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: You're creating a bigger cloud with your moping than Xal'atath's Voidstorm.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Speak your mind! Let it out before these feelings create a well of poison in your gut.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Xal'atath! If only I had found a way to destroy that accursed blade!

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Let your inner fires burn bright, my brethren! We are called to assault the Void!

name: Alonsus Faol
text: So you blame the Light, not your father?

name: Alonsus Faol
text: I must return to the Sunwell. The Vanguard needs my counsel.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: You're here, $n. We should join Arator inside. My sermon to these fanatics is falling on deaf ears.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: They claimed many relics when they seized my church. Relics that would be better used to our purpose of holding back Xal'atath.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: That is an excellent idea.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Kurdran flew to the entrance of Blackrock Spire, $n. He's tracked down the next fragment.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: I'll pull Turalyon away from his duties. Not an easy feat by any means.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: It will give Arator time to finish reforging his father's shield. He could use your assistance.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: The Light seeks a path. It does not dictate the way.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: That is my second lesson. The Light is channeled through belief and conviction. Even if they are misguided.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Why do you still have the shield? Didn't you give it to your father?

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Philosophically different from our Church of Holy Light, but with the same ability to channel the energy.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: That's... disappointing. I had hoped for a different reaction.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: The Light needs a lens to focus its power through the wielder. The Light brings certainty, and it responds to one's conviction.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Look at all the cultures across Azeroth that channel the Light. From Elune, to Gral, to An'she.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Arator... Light be praised, perhaps this all happened for a reason.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: We are on a hunt for artifacts to support the defenders at Silvermoon.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: What if I promised that my task would take you far away from here?

name: Alonsus Faol
text: No, Arator. My hope is that you can find a different path to follow.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: Arator, I did not mean to add to your burdens. The trip to the cathedral was necessary to save the Sunwell.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: $n, if you could deliver the relics. I need to have a word in private with Arator.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: With the relics delivered, the Sunwell is safe, for now.

name: Alonsus Faol
text: I spoke to you of finding a different path, Arator. I think it's time we started on it.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: The sheer power... Perhaps the ren'dorei are onto something after all.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Oh, how they raged! What fun.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Elemental? Arcane? I care not whence the anguish flows.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: I am well positioned to turn pain into power...

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Such energy! If I could command but a fraction of this power...

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Wretched... What an apt name. They have survived a long time, adrift. Harness their tenacity.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Do you feel it? Do you feel the power? The anguish?

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: The Twilight's Blade serve Xal'atath, but even lackeys wield power. Let us take what's theirs.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Their zealotry was admirable. I shall ensure their sacrifice was worthy.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: The brighter the blaze, the more exquisite the burn.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Metal is no match for magic.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: My colleagues are searching for methods to protect our city. I have my own solution.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Meet me near the harbor and I will reveal to you another path...

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: I have been tracking these threats to our realm for some time. They are quite tenacious.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Be careful, champion. Our magic is almost as deadly as our prey.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: If you give them an inch, they will seek to claim the upper hand.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Do not end them yet. Savor the hunt, and let the artifact consume their fear.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Such wonderful terror.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Your target is harvesting power here. Destroy the sources and evade their little guards.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: We simply cannot have them gaining the upper hand, can we?

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: As if it were made to withstand something as volatile as anguish... This bodes well.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Do not get caught so quickly. I intend to savor this.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Subtlety isn't your strength, is it?

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Oh, I won't let you be killed that quickly.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: The crystal reacts favorably to your touch. Duly noted.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: A skilled hunter is capable of disarming any trap placed before them.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: A hasty hunter is oft bitten...

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: I knew you could handle yourself, but that was truly delightful to watch.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: This one burns rather brightly. Extinguish their flame.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: This one is small in stature, yet great in power. Do not underestimate them.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: I admire the tenacity of my void-fallen brethren. Let us harness it.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: K'aresh produced some of the deadliest predators in the cosmos. This is one of them.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: This creature can be rather... temperamental.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: I am not one to dismiss the power of the trolls. Let us harness it.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Not even the Farstriders are immune to corruption and treachery.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Ah, the Light. A power close to my heart. Let us reclaim it from those who have strayed.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: The domanaar are Xal'atath's elite, and therefore a most enticing target...

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Ah, the scurrying rat has stopped to catch its breath. Eviscerate it.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: My magic reveals their little hiding spot. Go cover it in blood.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Oh, how close they are now. Can you taste their fear? I can--and it is exquisite.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: One misstep was all it took. Make them regret giving up their pathetic holdout.

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: I will enjoy scrying this one. Perform for me. Slaughter them.

name: Grand Magister Rommath
text: This is no simple cantrip! Keep firing and try not to die!

name: Grand Magister Rommath
text: Use this arcane projector to keep us informed.

name: Grand Magister Rommath
text: You were warned, Umbric! The Terrace is forever closed to you! Now leave before--

name: Grand Magister Rommath
text: You'll go no further, Umbric. These new defenses were specially made with you in mind.

name: Grand Magister Rommath
text: But Umbric-

name: Grand Magister Rommath
text: How dare the Amani threaten the sin'dorei again!

name: Grand Magister Rommath
text: You are not needed!

name: Decimus
text: If you're going to degrade me, Lothraxion, you could at least put some effort into it.

name: Decimus
text: If you prefer to keep throwing naaru at Nexus-Points, don't let me stop you.

name: Decimus
text: Borrow my pet's sight. I'll tell you how to weaken the storm.

name: Decimus
text: You and Lady Windrunner are simply wonderful. I've not encountered such capable mortals in my many travels.

name: Decimus
text: I'm eager to see what violence you may next wreak.

name: Decimus
text: I have all I need. Mourn your friend after we save your city.

name: Decimus
text: Jumping at shadows, in fear of deceit? Quite a unique variety of nathrezim you are, Lothraxion.

name: Decimus
text: My. Let's have it, then.

name: Decimus
text: No more, no more. How can I deny you after a display like that?

name: Decimus
text: Ah, the rest of our party arrives. Were there time, I'd have you for dinner.

name: Decimus
text: ... Gave myself away, did I?

name: Decimus
text: Make yourself at home. Then we can discuss weakening the storm.

name: Decimus
text: Come, $p. I have so much to show you.

name: Decimus
text: Oh. Now that is something.

name: Decimus
text: Ow. Ha. Hahaha.

name: Decimus
text: And cause an energy surge that would obliterate precious Silvermoon? Shut them down safely--spare your poor city.

name: Decimus
text: The key to weakening the storm is an artifact known as the Mantle of Predation.

name: Decimus
text: With it, you may enter a Nexus-Point and simply shut it down. Doing so will nullify the others in a cascade.

name: Decimus
text: Can you feel it? The Mantle is close at hand.

name: Decimus
text: Steal the Mantle of Predation, enter a Nexus-Point, and weaken the storm. Oh, Terminas will be humiliated.

name: Decimus
text: How fortunate that he's busy here, leaving his vault unguarded.

name: Decimus
text: "Lord" Terminas. He keeps the Mantle at the Obscurion Citadel.

name: Decimus
text: I am a creature of passion.

name: Decimus
text: On the fringes of this world, you will find Nexus-Points. They keep the storm churning.

name: Decimus
text: Watching your struggles blazing bright against an uncaring cosmos--it's delicious.

name: Decimus
text: Xal'atath would devour your world. All worlds. Even the stars.

name: Decimus
text: She would leave nothing but an empty abyss. Can you imagine anything more dull?

name: Decimus
text: I need no master. We should all obey our own appetites.

name: Decimus
text: The cosmos is a feast, lightling. Why not enjoy it?

name: Decimus
text: Delicious. Already halfway to unlocking the Mantle.

name: Decimus
text: Devour it. Feel her authority become yours.

name: Decimus
text: I am as good as my word, mortal.

name: Decimus
text: Stirring. Some friendly advice: never trust a domanaar who feigns subservience.

name: Decimus
text: I had no idea Lady Windrunner held a dark naaru of her own. This is more than mere entertainment...

name: Decimus
text: Ah, the ethereals. It was not so long ago that Xal'atath brought them into the fold.

name: Decimus
text: Break her toys and fight to the top of the food chain. Dear little Torentia will take it as a challenge.

name: Decimus
text: Mercy won't get you far out here. But I'll consider it offered in good faith.

name: Decimus
text: Azerothians! Oh, you'll make exquisite trophies.

name: Decimus
text: My, what a delicious bloodbath! But I'm afraid I must take my leave.

name: Decimus
text: If he damages the Nexus-Point, the resulting energy surge will obliterate your precious Silvermoon.

name: Decimus
text: Such strength and wisdom! Clearly, it would be foolish to defy you!

name: Decimus
text: That's what she told Salhadaar. Perhaps it was even the truth.

name: Decimus
text: Truly fascinating. You continue to defy expectations.

name: Decimus
text: Stop that Light-addled fool. Then I will join you and use the Mantle to weaken the storm.

name: Hagar
text: Come below when you're recovered. The others await.

name: Hagar
text: Our ancestors traveled for weeks, finding strange peoples deep below Mount Hyjal. They thought the haranir were strange too.

name: Hagar
text: The deeper they went, the more fearsome their foes became. But they were haranir, and they would not be prey.

name: Hagar
text: The root-tenders of Har'mara require help. Will you lend a hand?

name: Hagar
text: I understand the threat of the Lightbloom, but we need to appease the elders or you will have two enemies in Harandar.

name: Hagar
text: If rutaani march on your home, then perhaps their kin know of it. You will find some here.

name: Hagar
text: Help has arrived, little sprout.

name: Hagar
text: Peace, Orweyna. Ruia will face judgment. Come, we should fall back to the Suncrown Tree.

name: Hagar
text: The elders control the Alndust supply. I doubt they will be keen to share it with outsiders.

name: Hagar
text: In the deepest places, our people faced the others. They tore at flesh and devoured minds. Many were lost. But still, the haranir followed the Song.

name: Hagar
text: Aln'hara guide you. Good luck.

name: Hagar
text: Koozat is normally very calm, but can be quite dangerous when agitated. Be careful, $n.

name: Hagar
text: Most rutaani are very territorial. This is one of the few places we interact with them in peace.

name: Hagar
text: The elders have spoken. They hope that reliving the past will show you the folly of your actions.

name: Hagar
text: Ah, you're awake. Welcome to Har'mara.

name: Hagar
text: Bitterbloom flowered overnight in Har'alnor. Burn it before it spreads any further.

name: Hagar
text: Good work. We need to always be wary and keep the Blinding Bloom in check.

name: Hagar
text: The final mural holds our most sacred memory -- and our most ancient shame. To witness it, you will need a fragment we store away from the rest.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: The enemy attacks from the north. Be on guard, $p!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: The enemy is threatening to overwhelm our western defenses--we need help there!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: Here. Hieron is too modest. You can tell him I said that.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: The enemy is coming. Protect the Singularity Anchor!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: Drive them back--the Singularity Anchor is taking damage!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: The Singularity Anchor is heavily damaged! It can't take much more!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: The device is lost. Regroup and prepare yourselves. We shall try again shortly.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: This Singularity Anchor should be able to temporarily seal the Void anomalies. We must protect it while it charges.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: Additional defenses are available--activate them!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: Quickly, defend our western front!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: The Shadowguard are upon us!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: The might of the Devouring Host is arrayed against us! Hold fast, champion!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: They are pressing our southern defenses!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: The whispers grow evermore enticing, but we stand strong. Our mission demands it.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: The enemy is approaching from the south. Don't let them reach the Singularity Anchor!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: Stop them from attacking the Singularity Anchor!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: Quickly, champion. Prepare the defenses around the Singularity Anchor before the enemy arrives!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: We held them back. The Singularity Anchor has activated!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: In his absence, Terminas's lieutenants control access to his vault.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: We'll follow him, my lady. Ren'dorei, with me.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: Torentia controls the trench, Severum guards the upper citadel.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: Stop wasting my time!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: Everdawn--No! Curses!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: It is like drowning, flailing your arms out... but we will learn to swim.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: The Shadowguard's machinations continue in spite of our best efforts. Disrupt their operations.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: That should put a dent in their operations.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: Our scouts discovered an ethereal manaforge due south. Not sure what they're up to, though.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: A fleeting victory, but an important one.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: We are deep in enemy territory. Time to strike!

name: Riftblade Maella
text: I was separated from Hieron and Lady Darkglen. You must find them.

name: Riftblade Maella
text: The enemy is gathering to the east--shore up our defenses there!

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: Not all heeded the goddess's call, but the Hara'ti followed the Song.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: The journey was long and very difficult. We faced many hardships on the way.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: We grew to become the forest's greatest hunters.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: Rivaling, and then taming the fiercest predators.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: Hiding was not our only talent.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: One trial yet remains. Hagar is waiting for you ahead. May Aln'hara be with you, $n.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: We learned the shape of the beasts.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: We battled our way through the roots, and found ourselves in Harandar. But that is a deeper, more dangerous tale.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: In times of quiet, we felt empty. We longed for purpose.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: Countless generations ago our people walked beneath the trees of the great mountain.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: None knew of our presence. Not the giant whose steps shook the earth... nor her massive beasts.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: I was told you would be arriving, $n. Let us begin.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: Our longing was answered by a song from the depths of the world.

name: Zur'ashar Kassameh
text: Touch the painting. The Alndust within empowers it to reveal our truths.

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: I could use a hot meal and a drink while you ponder. Come with us, lad. You too, $n.

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: Khadgar introduced us. It's in some wizardy, hocus-pocus, dimensional whatzzuhthing. Hot food, cold drinks, magical access.

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: ...and so I said, "If that's my gryphon, who's sitting on the egg?"

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: Oh you must be joking!

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: Bah! Terrible idea! Worst I've ever heard.

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: Faol, I hope you know what you are doing.

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: To have a fine piece of equipment like that, well made, well repaired, languish on the wall until it rusts? That's shameful.

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: Well ain't that lovely. Come on lads. Time for a difficult walk down memory lane.

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: Lad, you don't seriously expect me to spoil his schemes? I'd never hear the end of it.

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: Seems like a good chance tae smash things up, if ye ask me. Let me know if ye want me tae join in the fun.

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: The orcs in the mountain don't just have a fragment--they're also stockpiling weapons.

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: Pfft! The Dark Horde. They're stuck trying to win the Second War, while we've made peace on the Fourth. Get with the times!

name: Kurdran Wildhammer
text: I could use a hot meal and a drink while you ponder. Come with us, lad. You too, $n.

name: Belath Dawnblade
text: The Voidstorm frightens the city, for good reason.

name: Belath Dawnblade
text: Busier than usual in here. We need to act fast.

name: Belath Dawnblade
text: It ends here, Lithiel!

name: Belath Dawnblade
text: Use the disguises and find the goods.

name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
text: Even now, in my moment of victory, I must bow and scrape before her!

name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
text: How I wish I could watch you all die! T'era, destroy them!

name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
text: The naaru has fallen! All this power... pledged to Xal'atath... while I have nothing in return!

name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
text: The Shadowguard risk everything to strengthen the Devouring Host. Should Windrunner discover what we are doing--

name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
text: You especially, $r. Do not think I've forgotten our last encounter.

name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
text: This is not what I was promised! We toil endlessly while your monsters monitor our every move!

name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
text: Do you think I cannot see the trap you have set? The peril that now faces my people should our operation at Mid'Ar fail?

name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
text: Windrunner will not prevent me from turning the naaru to the Void. I will claim the power I was promised!

name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
text: They will not stop me! Not this time! Shadowguard, slay them!

name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
text: Enough of your veiled threats, Xal'atath! You will have your naaru and I will have what I am owed!

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: I have used de shadows to see inside de cavern. I have seen my people--dead, alive, or... both.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: I fear they be sacrificed for some dark purpose. Come. I will guide you. We gonna rescue my people.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: If de maker of that monstrosity be here, we must stop them. And make sure their creation is put down.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: Good. Real good. You put de fear of de forest tribes back in dem.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: He be de one bringin' my people here... Keep outta his way--for now.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: It be worse than we thought. How many of my people have died here?

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: $n. Oraka'zul! I am blessed ya be here to prowl with me.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: Beware de mist, Zul'jarra. It be unnatural, an' we suspect de Vilebranch hidin' their dark deeds with it.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: What she doin'? She's rendin' de souls. Twisting dem! Feeding dem to that monster!

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: Den stop de Vilebranch from kidnappin' us in de middle of de night!

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: There are souls still that we can save. You confront her. I gonna release all de souls I can find.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: She's dead, but her evil lives on.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: There still be many angry souls. I will keep them busy--an' keep them from feedin' de monster.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: But de monster be up to you.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: A good kill, $n. And I rescued all that were still alive. But why did Muro'jin bring them here?

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: We are under attack. De Vilebranch--

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: De kidnapping won't stop until we get to de root of de evil. Follow me.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: Be careful, $n. He seems powerful... an' unstable.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: With de creature dead an' de Vilebranch gone, we Witherbark all be sleepin' a little safer--for now.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: We will always be lookin' over our shoulders at de Vilebranch. Come back with me. De chief be havin' a reward for ya.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: That... not be natural. And the energy flowing into it... This is hex magic.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: Using the souls of de dead in powerful magic spells... I hope this is not why they brought my kin here.

name: Kul'amara the Fierce
text: De Twilight's Blade are sabotagin' our lumberyard again! Save what lightwood you can find and hit dem back--hard.

name: Amarakk
text: If you insist on doing this, then you need to protect your mind and spirit with the Alndust.

name: Amarakk
text: Find me once you are prepared. And Orweyna... Be careful.

name: Amarakk
text: Even average-sized manifestations offer very little Alndust. You would be hunting for years just to gather a thimble's worth.

name: Amarakk
text: Blackened roots. Focus, Orweyna! Listen to my voice!

name: Amarakk
text: You found yourself. Good. Your friend was not so lucky.

name: Amarakk
text: Grab the Alndust now, $p. Be swift.

name: Amarakk
text: Alndust's power is of the goddess herself. If it can help your cause, Orweyna, then I will help you gather it.

name: Amarakk
text: He is not fully lost. But he must be removed from the rift immediately.

name: Amarakk
text: In the rift's darkest depths, Alndust coalesces into the monstrosities before you.

name: Amarakk
text: The manifestations pose a grave danger, but they are also the most plentiful source of Alndust.

name: Amarakk
text: Fungara Village is beyond saving. You may mourn later, but you must destroy them now.

name: Amarakk
text: These will give us a fighting chance to take down a manifestation.

name: Amarakk
text: Alndust bolsters our people's power over nature. It should be enough to counteract the Lightbloom's rapid growth.

name: Amarakk
text: After all this time, you return and seek entry into the rift? You have not changed at all, Orweyna.

name: Amarakk
text: There is no glory in destruction. But our duty remains all the same.

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: De loa always heed us in times of crisis. Dey may listen now to de right voice--someone on de path of de hash'ey!

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: I need my staff. Akil'zon will never grant me favor again if I abandon de staff in battle!

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: You did not know de world with de loa in it, my child. Dey were our strength. Our hope.

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: Zul'jarra! Your brother refused to wait. He took de warriors and he's gonna get dem killed!

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: You saved your brother. And you defended your right to lead as Zul'jin's granddaughter--all on your own.

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: Akil'zon bestowed on me a great honor when she made me her speaker.

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: If anyone can get to de loa and get answers, it is you.

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: Light de shrines on your way to de temple. And don't forget to leave Akil'zon an offerin'!

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: I tried to instill in de both of you--you and Zul'jan--a love for de loa.

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: How much do you remember about goin' to Akil'zon's temple?

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: No, my Jarra. As my niece. Because I know you have de fire. And I love you more than anythin'.

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: Just a minute now, Jan-boy.

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: My staff! You got de eyes of our blessed Akil'zon herself.

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: Hah! That's what I used to tell you when you were a child!

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: You were with me as a child when I last went to Akil'zon's temple, Zul'jarra. Do you not remember?

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: Many are still recoverin' from de Twilight's Blade attack. Help us gather herbs 'round de Shrine of Kulzi for medicine.

name: Loa Speaker Kinduru
text: Praise Kulzi. De stems and roots you bring will give relief to all de wounded in our care.

name: Lord Antenorian
text: Infiltrators seek to destroy all we have accomplished! Cut them down!

name: Lord Antenorian
text: Magister Umbric! How goes your research?

name: Lord Antenorian
text: Void take you all!

name: Lord Antenorian
text: INFILTRATORS! TO ARMS!

name: Lord Antenorian
text: I will not die like them!

name: Lord Antenorian
text: Do not fear, my devoted. With your strength I open a new path!

name: Lord Antenorian
text: I did... all... I was asked...

name: Lord Antenorian
text: There is no salvation! We must save ourselves!

name: Lord Antenorian
text: A cult? That is a most serious accusation.

name: Lord Antenorian
text: Really? How very odd indeed.

name: Lord Antenorian
text: I shall have it looked into. But I'm glad you're here--I need your assistance with something.

name: Lord Antenorian
text: I cannot thank you three enough for taking the town's safety seriously.

name: Lord Antenorian
text: I shall look into your investigation. We'll compare notes later.

name: Lord Antenorian
text: My sympathies, Magister. I'll see that someone takes care of the body.

name: Ruia
text: No chance!

name: Ruia
text: But with it comes hubris. Recklessness.

name: Ruia
text: Remember the claws!

name: Ruia
text: Bleed for your crimes!

name: Ruia
text: You bleed!

name: Ruia
text: Your pride endangers everything we've built here!

name: Ruia
text: Pitiful Orweyna. You cannot stop the Lightbloom alone.

name: Ruia
text: No! Not here, not yet!

name: Ruia
text: Presumptuous whelp. Your transgressions end here.

name: Ruia
text: Yield, surface-dwellers! Your Light returns to wash over you!

name: Ruia
text: Invading our gardens has a price, and the Lightbloom will make sure you pay it.

name: Ruia
text: This so-called "Lightbloom" is no real threat. It does not excuse your heresies.

name: Ruia
text: The Lightbloom is beyond control. You cannot hold it back forever.

name: Ruia
text: With the Lightbloom, I can restore the haranir to what we must be. But you stand in my way.

name: Ruia
text: Behold my power!

name: Ruia
text: You have forgotten the value of tradition, Orweyna. Go to the Den of Echoes, and remind yourself of what it means to be haranir.

name: Ruia
text: Go to the Den at once! The Council will decide your fates.

name: Ruia
text: It was... for Harandar...

name: Ruia
text: Burn for me!

name: Ruia
text: You would have us spare Alndust for the sake of outsiders? Absurd!

name: Ruia
text: She of all people knows the cost to gather it. If she wants to waste it, then she can brave the rift for it herself.

name: Ruia
text: Light's wrath!

name: Ruia
text: Clearly, the hand of Aln'hara is upon you, child.

name: Ruia
text: I call the Light!

name: Ruia
text: Naive Orweyna. This frenzy shall lap at the heels of our sacred home no longer. I have turned the bloom back on its creators!

name: Ruia
text: Punish you all!

name: Nalorakk
text: Away, unworthy!

name: Nalorakk
text: Out of my sight.

name: Nalorakk
text: The last trial is at hand. Ready to test your strength and face my claws?

name: Nalorakk
text: My rage is unabated. Must I sleep for millennia?

name: Nalorakk
text: Disappointing, hash'ura.

name: Nalorakk
text: You are not my equal. Back to the dream of winter.

name: Nalorakk
text: Well done. Your strength rivals mine. The dream... ends.

name: Nalorakk
text: She has died honorably. But the death of those loyal to me... that is my burden. It will be yours as hash'ey.

name: Nalorakk
text: My rage will find you.

name: Nalorakk
text: Cannot escape the claws of the war god.

name: Nalorakk
text: Finally joining the battle? Show our foes what you learned from me!

name: Nalorakk
text: Fought like a true Amani, hash'ura!

name: Nalorakk
text: Leadership requires sacrifice. Even of the things we cherish.

name: Vidious
text: You like goods don't you? Then find them.

name: Vidious
text: Keep an eye out for opportunities for loot when they arise, like now!

name: Vidious
text: Someone is trying to build a fable, put an end to their story.

name: Vidious
text: Surprised the Horde could pull off such a thing.

name: Vidious
text: The ethereal's stored energy in the beacons here that will open up temporarily. Let's see who can capture the most.

name: Vidious
text: Standing around? And I thought the Alliance were fighters! Show me I was right.

name: Vidious
text: The Alliance won! Just as I expected!

name: Vidious
text: A test of battle prowess! Escort your domanaar to the end, and whoever makes it to the end wins!

name: Vidious
text: Those beasts could use a good taming. Then you can use them in battle.

name: Vidious
text: See? They have use. Remember that.

name: Vidious
text: The beacons are closing soon!

name: Vidious
text: The Horde won? How?

name: Vidious
text: And we have enough! That will do. Brave work.

name: Vidious
text: We still need some void-tainted remains. And thankfully, Slayer's Rise has them.

name: Vidious
text: Huh what's happening? Something big it seems.

name: Lilaju
text: De Revantusk also suffered heavy losses.

name: Lilaju
text: We are workin' as fast as we can. But many of our weapons were broken in de attack.

name: Lilaju
text: De Revantusk's best smiths be repairing our weapons, Zul'jarra.

name: Lilaju
text: Fine. To commune with de sleepin' Loa of War, ya must sit at his fire. But all that have did not come back.

name: Lilaju
text: Our village was raided by de Twilight's Blade. We need to replenish our food stores. You any good at hunting?

name: Lilaju
text: Not bad. These look fresher than what de furbolg trade with us. Accept this as de Revantusk's thanks.

name: Ziadan
text: The Horde were better this time. As I foresaw.

name: Ziadan
text: You have control now Horde, make them suffer.

name: Ziadan
text: Time is almost up.

name: Ziadan
text: Has the Horde grown weak or do you no longer want treasure? Go find it.

name: Ziadan
text: That looks like a treasure out in the distance. Don't miss this opportunity!

name: Ziadan
text: Take the early advantage and get your spoils.

name: Ziadan
text: The ethereal forces are recovering but are still disrupted. Grab a tool and dig into what could be happening.

name: Ziadan
text: The gravitational force here can provide extra power. Go use it to eliminate some of the ethereals.

name: Ziadan
text: That behemoth will take more than just you. Gather some help and take care of it.

name: Ziadan
text: You bugs work well as a swarm.

name: Ziadan
text: The job is done.

name: Ziadan
text: There's a strange aura here. Disrupt these ethereals and investigate what's going on.

name: Ziadan
text: Good. Remember what you learned here for later.

name: Ziadan
text: The Alliance gathered the most void. They won.

name: Ziadan
text: The disruption has calmed, for now.

name: Ziadan
text: Void power has been stored in those barrels. Siphon it and bring it back to your camp.

name: Ziadan
text: There's been a disruption with the ethereal energy up north. Get an ethereal tool. You will be able to harvest their energy among other things.

name: Ziadan
text: There are rumblings I can sense coming. Go explore Slayer's Rise and see what they are.

name: Torundo the Grizzled
text: I'll help Zul'jan prepare our ballistas once I see de children here to safety.

name: Torundo the Grizzled
text: Thanks for clearing de way, stranger.

name: Torundo the Grizzled
text: De loa? Dey abandoned us long ago.

name: Torundo the Grizzled
text: We will fly on de winds of Akil'zon--like in de olden days.

name: Torundo the Grizzled
text: It don't look good. All that's left be de old, de injured, and de hungry.

name: Torundo the Grizzled
text: Not many Amani made it back here.

name: Dundun
text: And from many sources, abundance flows... such as this ore. Go ahead. Mine away.

name: Dundun
text: Ores, herbs, skinnable creatures, and more are bountiful sources of abundance.

name: Dundun
text: And yes, even enemies. Fear not--this one was summoned for your instruction alone.

name: Dundun
text: Of course, harvested abundance serves no purpose within the depths of your rucksack.

name: Dundun
text: Approach any Altar of Abundance, and your acquired materials will be contributed efficiently and hastily.

name: Dundun
text: You have mastered the basics of abundance. Now, prove your worth in this smaller, curated domain.

name: Dundun
text: My blessing of abundance enhances your own abilities the more you harvest and contribute. Have you felt its strength?

name: Dundun
text: Uh oh. Your fragile body is reaching its limits here. I will forcibly remove you--for your protection, of course.

name: Dundun
text: An impressive start. Yet, know this: your true education in abundance unfolds through steadfast practice and diligent application.

name: Dundun
text: Truly abundant deeds shall be met with a gift: unalloyed abundance.

name: Dundun
text: Understand that this material is quite inimitable. I will only bestow it for your most abundant endeavors.

name: Dundun
text: If you would indulge me, please trade the unalloyed abundance I've gifted you.

name: Dundun
text: Prosperous plentitude, acolyte! May my abundance and glory rain down material worth upon your mortal existence.

name: Dundun
text: You seek abundance? It lies here in full measure! All you must do is harvest it!

name: Dundun
text: Delay not! Lest abundance be claimed without you!

name: Dundun
text: Enter my domain! Pursue the boundless glory of abundance!

name: Dundun
text: Hurry! Abundance will soon overwhelm your fragile form!

name: Dundun
text: Alas, alack, alacrity! Your abundant limit nears!

name: Dundun
text: Glow bright, acolyte! You have few abundant moments left!

name: Dundun
text: To me, young acolyte. Let us begin your tutelage.

name: Dundun
text: This is abundance.

name: Dundun
text: Well done, acolyte. Within my domains, you shall find abundance beyond measure.

name: Dundun
text: Go ahead. Walk to it, and it will heed your call.

name: War Chaplain Senn
text: We will not be tempted by your "offers" of help, Void elf.

name: War Chaplain Senn
text: I have marshalled what priests were available to ward against the Void. It won't repel the Devouring Host, but will prevent contamination from any undesirable mortals.

name: General Amias Bellamy
text: Then make sure we have everything we need and keep enemies off our backs.

name: General Amias Bellamy
text: All Vanguard forces to the Sunwell! Now!

name: General Amias Bellamy
text: As you will it, High Exarch.

name: General Amias Bellamy
text: Vanguard, collect every weapon not nailed to a wall and let's move out!

name: General Amias Bellamy
text: Forward! We will push back the shadows!

name: General Amias Bellamy
text: I'm worried that Void Elf might sneak back in here and disrupt our efforts at the Sunwell.

name: General Amias Bellamy
text: Lor'themar promised his Magisters would provide a solution. It's now or never!

name: General Amias Bellamy
text: And I am telling you that it is still not enough. Only by the faith of our forces is the Sunwell holding back the Void.

name: Vordaza
text: Go. Make dem suffer.

name: Vordaza
text: Enough! Ya cannot stand against de Vilebranch!

name: Vordaza
text: I gonna poison ya soul!

name: Vordaza
text: Ma'ako! Ma'ako ka shadra!

name: Vordaza
text: What's dis? New souls for my experiments?

name: Vordaza
text: You gonna be tormented from beyond de grave.

name: Vordaza
text: More souls for Rak'tul!

name: Vordaza
text: Ya soul be forfeit.

name: Vordaza
text: A weak soul. But it will do.

name: Vordaza
text: De soul harvest continues.

name: Vordaza
text: An'daka taz no shada. Ke zulo numra kan! Ne'hideh. Ne'hideh!

name: Vordaza
text: Hah! I control de power of life an' death. Of course my magic too strong for dem.

name: Vordaza
text: Ya accomplished nothin'. Rak'tul will still rise!

name: Vordaza
text: Dis affliction hit hard.

name: Commander Venel Lightblood
text: I appreciate your concerns, Koruth. For my people, the Light and the Sunwell are the same. They may complain, but they will accept the Vanguard.

name: Commander Venel Lightblood
text: Keep going! Do not succumb to the darkness!

name: Commander Venel Lightblood
text: Release the Void-wielders. They may wander the city, but we will tolerate none of their taint near the Sunwell.

name: Hannan
text: It came from above. Within a few days, it overtook all of Shaladrassil.

name: Hannan
text: By the Goddess...

name: Loa Speaker Brek
text: Could it be... de spark? De fire we need?

name: Loa Speaker Brek
text: I see de fire in you, yes. Find more coals, more fire. Renew de livin' flame!

name: Loa Speaker Brek
text: Yes! De flame returns. De fire of Jan'alai burns bright! Fly home, mistress an' master of fire! Fly!

name: Loa Speaker Brek
text: De coal ready to burn now. Burn an' purify. De shrines show de way.

name: Loa Speaker Brek
text: De flame rises. Rise to the challenge. Cleanse ya spirit!

name: Loa Speaker Brek
text: Behold! De last trial. Face to face. Face yaself!

name: Loa Speaker Brek
text: Place de coal! Watch de flames rise and de fire live again!

name: Loa Speaker Brek
text: De livin' flame be gone, burned in many hearts. Purify yaself, an' it will rise!

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: Faol! What brings you and your friends to Hammerfall? Please tell me the world isn't ending again.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: $n, if you could help with cleanup and deliveries. Arator can help me with some work that needs another pair of hands.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: But war changed what his paladins were called to do.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: One moment--this post is being stubborn.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: For some. Others are content to smite the wicked with a giant hammer.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: What type of paladin do you want to be, Arator? What type of person?

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: But allowing the innocent to suffer... that is the worst evil.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: Alonsus has told me how he always intended for the Silver Hand to focus on this kind of service.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: Alonsus tells me stories of his first students. The legendary Uther was apparently quite the nurse.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: I would have liked to meet the man during that time.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: I don't know the High Exarch well. I do know he's been to other worlds, far from here. Fighting for an unimaginable amount of time.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: The fields are cleared of scrap metal! We'll make something useful out of this refuse.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: We're shaped by the events in our lives. But we can choose how we will live going forward.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: $n, if you would gather what you can, Arator and I will prepare the forge.

name: Sunwalker Dezco
text: The discarded weapons of past wars litter the fields and complicate farming.

name: Elder Doru
text: I hope Zul'jan brought more lightwood back. I'm tired of workin' with only leftover scraps.

name: Lady Darkglen
text: The Void has a curious impact on the life of this world. Reach into these creatures and capture their instincts. I must know what fuels them.

name: Lady Darkglen
text: Survival at any cost. Finally, a world with sensible rules.

name: Lady Darkglen
text: Dust yourself off, ren'dorei. You have not succumbed yet.

name: Lady Darkglen
text: Fear not for my sanity, $p. My minion and I are well used to such madness.

name: Lady Darkglen
text: Find that old fool. I'll give him an earful for playing hero.

name: Commander Koruth Mountainfist
text: Agreed. This city's a powder keg ready to go.

name: Commander Koruth Mountainfist
text: If we could just take the fight to Xal'atath, we'd give her such a drumming she'd hop back inside that knife.

name: Commander Koruth Mountainfist
text: If you say so, Venel. It just seems we're ruffling too many gryphon feathers.

name: Commander Koruth Mountainfist
text: The Light offers respite! But ye must press on!

name: Ku'paal
text: Orweyna, I beg you. You know where Alndust falls.

name: Ku'paal
text: Those who walk the rift without guidance risk being forever lost.

name: Ku'paal
text: Two of our young are still out here!

name: Ku'paal
text: Orweyna? Who are these--what have you done?

name: Ku'paal
text: Her screams of anguish give life to formless terrors and drive those who enter mad.

name: Ku'paal
text: When the goddess was torn from her Cradle, the violence left wounds that will not heal.

name: Ku'paal
text: If you must go, you will need the Shul'ka. How you feel about him cannot change that.

name: On'hiea
text: YOU! You took her. Stole her away! I'll kill you all!!

name: On'hiea
text: GONE. STOLEN! Where has she gone?
